TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_00: Ojika Tsunjika has a message for you.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_01: Ojika Tsunjika has had word from Erenville─apparently the gleaner's efforts to secure passage to Tural aboard a guildship vessel were successful. The administration officer bids you wait in the main hall while he informs the rest of your travel companions.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_02: Gathered together, you and the others reaffirm your reasons for undertaking the journey west, as well as your support of Wuk Lamat's bid for the throne. Satisfied that everyone is committed to the cause, Erenville suggests you make ready to depart.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_03: The time to leave Sharlayan behind has come. Board the guildship vessel and undertake the journey to Tural.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_04:
With a vast stretch of ocean still between you and Tural's shores, Krile suggests you pass the time by conversing with your fellow shipmates─some of whom have made the trip to Tuliyollal before.

※In the event that you leave the ship, you may resume your voyage by speaking with the sprightly sailor in Scholar's Harbor.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_05: Your brief bout of socialization has yielded insights into what to expect when you arrive at your destination. Krile may be interested to hear what you have learned.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_06: The ship is beset by a terrible storm, but thanks to the heroic actions of those on board, the passengers and crew survive to see the seas grow calm once more. Your vessel sails on, the sight of wheeling seabirds signaling that Tural is now but a short distance away. Erenville explains that the larger vessel is unable to enter the city's harbor, so you board a landing boat alongside your comrades.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_07: You at last make landfall in Tuliyollal─much to the relief of Wuk Lamat and her roiling stomach. Upon your arrival, you are accosted by Turali soldiers, who are quickly put at ease by the reassurances of the Third Promise.
TEXT_KINGMA101_04860_SEQ_08: Stoic as ever, Erenville stands ready to guide you as you take your first steps into the vibrant city of Tuliyollal. Go forth and see what adventure awaits!
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SEQ_00: While being on solid ground has improved Wuk Lamat's mood, her stomach appears to be lagging behind...
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SEQ_01: As Erenville prepares to guide you through the city, the suffering Wuk Lamat is approached by a handful of curious Turali. It would seem that the Third Promise's affable nature coupled with a large entourage of unusual outsiders is likely to see you being stopped on every street corner. Thus do you decide to split into two smaller─and hopefully less noticeable─parties. Erenville leaves with the twins in tow, while you and Krile are grouped with Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SEQ_02:
Pushing through her lingering bout of nausea, Wuk Lamat valiantly begins your tour of Tuliyollal with a brief introduction of the harbor. Next stop: Bayside Bevy.

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat and Krile to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SEQ_03:
Wuk Lamat introduces you to Tuliyollal's largest marketplace and reassures you that, although the local currency is “pel,” most shopkeepers will readily accept your gil as payment. She then directs you northwards up the stairs towards a certain plaza...

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat and Krile to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SEQ_04:
At the plaza, Wuk Lamat explains how Koana brought the knowledge of aetheryte construction back with him from Sharlayan. Seeing the value in the technology at once, the Dawnservant ordered that a crystal be built immediately. After reminding you to complete your attunement, she then urges you onwards to Brightploom Post and the city gate beyond.

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat and Krile to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SEQ_05:
You make a stop at Brightploom Post, the headquarters for the Landsguard. Charged with keeping the peace and the defense of the nation, these soldiers are under the direct command of Zoraal Ja, the martially gifted First Promise. Leaving the guardhouse behind, Wuk Lamat shepherds you along to the Xak Tural skygate.

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat and Krile to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SEQ_06:
You learn that the imposing skygate opens onto a similarly massive bridge─a Yok Huy construction which enables passage to Xak Tural, the northern landmass of Tural. Those wishing to make the journey require a travel permit, however, which will not be issued until the rite of succession is decided.

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat and Krile to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMA102_04861_SEQ_07: Krile estimates the tour has taken you around half the city. You rest your feet a moment, with Wuk Lamat seemingly content to wait until you are ready to continue exploring Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMA103_04862_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is ready to commence the second half of your Tuliyollal tour.
TEXT_KINGMA104_04863_SEQ_00: Krile regards the stone pillars curiously.
TEXT_KINGMA105_04864_SEQ_00: Erenville has been waiting patiently for your arrival.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_SEQ_00: The helpful Hanu is waiting to answer your questions.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_SEQ_01: In response to Wuk Lamat's query, the Hanu warns that the region of Kozama'uka has been battered by the recent storm. Not only has the trail devolved into a muddy mess, but the village of Ok'hanu itself has suffered losses as a direct result of the tempest's wrath. Worried for the state of the Hanu people, Wuk Lamat bids you make ready to depart and assemble by the Arch of the Dawn.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_SEQ_02: An elector likely awaits in Kozama'uka, and the time has come to seek them out. Thus do you and your comrades leave to retrace the steps of the Dawnservant.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_SEQ_03: Your party makes their way towards Ok'hanu, following the road alongside the river. Wuk Lamat quickens her pace as the village draws near, leaving you and your Scion companions to continue on your own.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_SEQ_04: Though somewhat awed by Wuk Lamat's relentless momentum, Krile trusts that Erenville will keep the Third Promise from getting lost or worse. With but one direction ahead of you, you proceed down the road presumably leading to your destination.
TEXT_KINGMA106_04865_SEQ_05: You endure the trek across swampy ground to arrive in Ok'hanu. Now to enter the village proper, and seek out the Dawnservant's elector...
TEXT_KINGMA107_04866_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat wishes to seek out the Dawnservant's elector.
TEXT_KINGMA108_04867_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is eager to help solve the Hanuhanu's woes.
TEXT_KINGMA109_04868_SEQ_00: Linuhanu wishes to take you to the shipwright.
TEXT_KINGMA110_04869_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat settles down to rest before the festival gets underway.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SEQ_00: Wuk Evu wishes to spread word that the festival will soon be held.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SEQ_01: With Bakool Ja Ja's clumsy attempt to steal the float thwarted, the festivities can proceed as planned. Wuk Evu suggests that you let the villagers know that Ihih'hana will be held after all. True to form, he also strongly urges you to remember the traditional greeting when approaching the Hanuhanu. With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter any phrase containing the word “Ohokaliy” to greet the Ok'hanu villagers.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SEQ_02: The mere knowledge that Ihih'hana will take place seemingly infuses the dejected villagers with eager anticipation. You can now return to Wuk Evu and commence the long-awaited festival.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SEQ_03: Chosen by Linuhanu as the festival's guest of honor, Wuk Lamat boards the float and is carried in a growing procession towards the sacred site of Kozanuakiy. Once there, the true magic of Ihih'hana manifests, the concentrated aether of the festival-goers harnessed and dispersed throughout the land in a spectacular display. You and your companions rush to check the fields, where Wuk Lamat looks over the now-revitalized reeds with an expression of awe.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SEQ_04: Owing to the festivities, the better part of the fields have been restored. The remainder is soon tended to by Koana, who arrives with an alchemical concoction prepared with the aid of his “Archon allies”─an explanation which gives you and your comrades pause. Overjoyed with Wuk Lamat and Koana's successful efforts, Zanuhali awards them both with a keystone. The feat is complete, and your party now looks to return to Tuliyollal in preparation for the next challenge.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SEQ_05: Still giddy from the festival and her success with the reeds, Wuk Lamat thinks back on the wonderful people she's met on her journey. Excited for the encounters still to come, she ushers you along back to Tuliyollal and Xbalyav Ty'e.
TEXT_KINGMA111_04870_SEQ_06: Wuk Lamat is inordinately pleased with her progress thus far. With luck, the next stage of the contest will continue just as smoothly...
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_SEQ_00: The approachable Pelu is awaiting your questions.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_SEQ_01: You learn from the approachable Pelu that the road to Urqopacha has been made almost impassable by the recent storm. He does, however, offer to share a solution for traversing the difficult terrain before bidding you follow.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_SEQ_02: Your road leads to Urqopacha. To embark upon the journey, you and your companions make your way to the alpaca stables.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_SEQ_03: Much to Wuk Lamat's dismay, the Pelu suggests your party make use of alpacas for the journey to Urqopacha. The ride is relatively uneventful, and upon arriving in the region you meet with Bol Noq', a weaver who has just come from Wachunpelo. The affable soul proceeds to share with you a cautionary tale about making business deals with the Pelupelu while under the influence of their locally brewed spirit. Afterwards, Wuk Lamat charges on ahead, impulsive as ever, and the rest of you trail after her into the village.
TEXT_KINGMA112_04871_SEQ_04: Erenville finds Wuk Lamat on the verge of making an unnecessary purchase, which leads him to chide her for doing the exact opposite of what was just discussed. The Pelupelu, you learn, are a clan of avid merchants and adroit conversationalists, and bringing happiness through trade is a core tenet of their culture. While they won't seek to deceive customers or sell them faulty wares, Erenville cautions that only a clear refusal will convince the diminutive people that there is no sale to be made.
TEXT_KINGMA113_04872_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is ready to search out the Dawnservant's elector.
TEXT_KINGMA114_04873_SEQ_00: Erenville wishes to discuss the Feat of Gold.
TEXT_KINGMA115_04874_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat steels herself for the ride to find your next trading partner.
TEXT_KINGMA116_04875_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat has her eye on a jug of premium mezcal.
TEXT_KINGMA117_04876_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is ready to return to Havli.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_SEQ_00: Mablu is minded to rush ahead to the village.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_SEQ_01: Mindful of Wuk Lamat's exhausted state, Mablu offers to run ahead to the village and put on a pot of revitalizing mate tea. The others adopt a slower pace for the sake of the weakened Third Promise, leaving you free to lend Mablu a hand with teatime preparations.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_SEQ_02:
Wuk Lamat is feeling much recovered after her cup of tea, and confesses a newfound fondness for alpacas. As if on cue, Tobli arrives to inspect her captured beast, and declares that the Third Promise has met the requirements for accomplishing the Feat of Gold. When Wuk Lamat expresses her feelings of inferiority, however, the head ledger is prompted to share the story of Gulool Ja Ja's own visit to Wachunpelo many years ago, which culminated in the liberation of the Pelupelu from the Yok Huy.

Following this recitation, Tobli proceeds to award Wuk Lamat her keystone, urging her to be proud of her achievements in both the valley and the village itself. Mablu, grateful to Wuk Lamat for her encouragement, then announces to Tobli her desire to leave the ranch and take up the merchant profession─a desire which her adoptive father wholeheartedly endorses.

As you make to depart for Tuliyollal, Mablu suggests you speak with the Yok Huy about the legend of the golden city. According to local history, the giants once commanded the Pelupelu to search for the fabled metropolis. The revelations continue, as Mablu also recognizes Krile's earring, and offers to look into the origin of the jewelry which has long been worn as a charm of safe travel in Tural. After thanking her new Pelupelu friends for their advice and hospitality, Wuk Lamat sets her sights on the road back to the city.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_SEQ_03: Although still uncertain of her adequacy as a Promise, Wuk Lamat is nevertheless pleased to have accomplished the Feat of Gold. She puts aside her self-doubt for the time being and leads your entourage back to Xbalyav Ty'e in Tuliyollal.
TEXT_KINGMA118_04877_SEQ_04: Now back in her home city, Wuk Lamat has regained her characteristic optimism. Hoping to maintain your momentum, you prepare to embark on the next stage of the contest.
TEXT_KINGMA119_04878_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is eager to attempt the next feat.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat wonders how Fonjeantaine is getting on.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_01: Wuk Lamat is curious to know if Fonjeantaine will follow through with his resolution to practice his craft in Tuliyollal. She suggests heading back to Wachumeqimeqi to see if he has spoken with Ropli yet.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_02: You arrive in time to watch as Fonjeantaine finds his courage, and after explaining his situation to Ropli, the goldsmith successfully secures work as an artisan at Wachumeqimeqi. No sooner has he thanked you for your kind support than you receive a linkpearl call from Erenville. It seems he has finished making the necessary arrangements for your passage to the Moblin settlement.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_03:
Much to Wuk Lamat's dismay, it transpires that Erenville has requisitioned a large, barge-like boat which is to be pulled by a placid marine creature known as a punutiy. Koana then makes an unexpected appearance, along with his heretofore hidden collaborators─Thancred and Urianger. Your fellow Scions are seemingly delighted by the prospect of competing against their Archon comrades; however, now is not the occasion for such a competition, as the Second Promise will not be traveling on the river. Koana and his entourage soon depart, leaving you to prepare for the potential dangers of a journey along Ihuykatumu.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_04: The contest takes you now to Kozama'uka. But what awaits on your river voyage remains to be seen...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_05:
Your plans to defend the riverboat are soon tested as Bakool Ja Ja releases wild creatures from his own barge to harass and harry you. Aggravated by your prowess, the two-head then turns his attention to your punutiy, wounding the creature and damaging the front of your vessel. Erenville is thus forced to ground the boat while you scout on ahead.

A perilous detour through an abandoned Yok Huy mine sees you encounter Koana and his entourage─yet while the meeting does not come to blows, they delay your progress nonetheless. Eventually, you emerge near the river, where you are rejoined by Erenville, Alisaie, and the recovered punutiy.

Your group sets off again and presently arrives at Dock Tumu. Encouraged to let her guard down by you and your companions, it seems Wuk Lamat has much to think about as you make for the nearby mountain camp...
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_06: Wuk Lamat gathers her thoughts, at last persuaded that sharing her burden is not only accepted but encouraged. The campsite at the top of the Flight of We Wingless should provide a comfortable place for her to confess how she truly feels.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_07: An innocent question from Alisaie prompts Wuk Lamat to tell the story of her childhood with Gulool Ja Ja, culminating with the inadequacy she feels when compared to her accomplished brothers. With the aid of you and Krile, however, the Third Promise comes to better understand what it is that truly drives her. She resolves to continue her journey and to learn more of her beloved nation and its peoples as she walks a path of her own making.
TEXT_KINGMA120_04879_SEQ_08: In sharing her worries with her comrades, Wuk Lamat feels as though a crushing weight has been lifted from her breast, and she can take a full breath at last. Free from the burden of her self-imposed expectations, she is eager to carry on.
TEXT_KINGMB101_04880_SEQ_00: Erenville is concerned about dangers on the road.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SEQ_00: Rakorok needs help learning about the potsworn Kaahe.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SEQ_01: Rakorok has found himself in charge of the potsworn Kaahe but has no idea what the artisan might want or need to be more comfortable in Earthenshire. Warning that helphands do not question potsworn directly, the overworked Moblin bids you and Wuk Lamat observe Kaahe and attempt to ascertain his desires.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SEQ_02: You enter the workshop and note several things that could be affecting Kaahe's ability to concentrate on his work. After having a thorough look around, you and Wuk Lamat head back outside to share your observations with Rakorok.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SEQ_03: Wuk Lamat notes three factors that are likely hindering Kaahe's creative endeavors. The first of these is the artisan's piping hot meals, which the average Hhetsarro would not appreciate and which Wuk Lamat will discuss with the Moblin's cook. The second is the state of Kaahe's tools─an oversight which Rakorok is only too happy to correct. The third concerns the sweltering heat inside the Workpot, which you are tasked to alleviate by salvaging a “draftyshard” from nearby boat wrecks. According to Rakorok, you should be able to spot the tunnel to the shoals in question from just outside the village.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SEQ_04: Your search for the tunnel entrance is briefly interrupted by Koana and Thancred, who are out gathering herbs for treating the injured Moblins. Musing on the tenuous situation in Earthenshire, Koana seems preoccupied with the ways Sharlayan technology could improve the lives of his people. After the two depart, you soon spy the rocky passage you were looking for─southeast of the village, as Rakorok described.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SEQ_05: You wade through the shallows and pluck a wind-aspected crystal from the scattered wreckage in the shoals. With “draftyshard” in hand, you can now return to Earthenshire and the waiting Rakorok.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SEQ_06: Invigorated by your offerings of fine food, new tools, and a soothing breeze, Kaahe immediately sets to work crafting an exquisite oil lamp. Koana then arrives to inform Wuk Lamat of the feat's imminent commencement, and cannot help but be impressed by the potsworn's work. Rakorok, too, seems well pleased with Kaahe's dramatic change of attitude.
TEXT_KINGMB102_04881_SEQ_07: Wuk Lamat agrees with the grateful Rakorok that it is important to know as much as you can about the people you want to help. With that lesson fresh in mind, you prepare yourselves to face the impending Feat of Pots.
TEXT_KINGMB103_04882_SEQ_00: Koana has details to share concerning the forthcoming Feat of Pots.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat needs to pay a visit to the palace.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_SEQ_01: Wuk Lamat departs for Vollok Shoonsa, leaving you to your own devices. The suggestion to return to the For'ard Cabins and take a well-deserved rest, however, does sound very tempting...
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_SEQ_02: You head back to the cabins only to find a Landsguard soldier awaiting your arrival. It seems the Dawnservant has summoned you to the palace, and you are to present yourself to the gate guard stationed outside Sunperch.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_SEQ_03: Heeding the soldier's advice, you proceed to your appointment dressed for battle. Yet for what reason might such preparations be warranted?
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_SEQ_04: Upon entering Sunperch, Gulool Ja Ja soon makes it clear that his summons was an invitation to duel. You spar against the massive Mamool Ja, his powerful and viper-fast blows keeping you on your toes, until he is at last satisfied with your performance. Impressed by your battlecraft, the Dawnservant follows the bout with a father's earnest request to watch over his daughter. It is then that Wuk Lamat arrives. She chides Gulool Ja Ja for stealing away her champion, and exits the throne room with you in tow.
TEXT_KINGMB104_04883_SEQ_05: Annoyed by her father's antics, Wuk Lamat wonders if Gulool Ja Ja has been bothering you with things other than duels─a query you deflect with a noncommittal answer. The Dawnservant's plea remains at the forefront of your mind, however, as you accompany the Third Promise on the continuation of her journey.
TEXT_KINGMB105_04884_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat thinks it time to gather her allies for the road ahead.
TEXT_KINGMB106_04885_SEQ_00: Koana is anxious to begin the search for Wuk Lamat.
TEXT_KINGMB107_04886_SEQ_00: Koana wishes to execute the final stage of his plan.
TEXT_KINGMB108_04887_SEQ_00: Koana wishes to gather your companions for the upcoming rescue mission.
TEXT_KINGMB109_04888_SEQ_00: Koana is nervously awaiting the call from Thancred.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat has her sights set on the Yok Huy village.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_SEQ_01: Eager to be on her way, Wuk Lamat urges your party onwards towards the Yok Huy village. The path you are to take begins in the spot where you first encountered Wawkesa, west of Earthenshire.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_SEQ_02: Wuk Lamat is not about to let the loss of a keystone slow her down. She makes a brief stop in Earthenshire to reassure Rediroq that all is well, then wastes no time stomping up the mountain path after Erenville.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_SEQ_03: Your party reaches the end of the arduous trail, exhausted by the climb and the noticeably thinner air. Erenville shares some advice for enduring the heightened elevation, before encouraging you along the last few steps to Worlar's Echo.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_SEQ_04: In response to Wuk Lamat's observations, Erenville explains that the Yok Huy are rarely seen in the lowlands─bound as they are to their duty of watching over the imprisoned Valigarmanda. The Third Promise briefly considers delaying the feats in favor of hunting down the thieving Bakool Ja Ja, but cooler heads prevail, and you head over to the temple to inquire after the whereabouts of the elector.
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_SEQ_05: You are granted entrance to Karryorzar the Gracious, and are immediately awestruck by the sight of the enormous Valigarmanda bound within its prison of ice. Zurmurwur, a temple priest, tells the story of Gulool Ja Ja's battle with the seemingly unbeatable tural vidraal, ending with the Skyruin's frozen fate. Putting concerns of melting ice aside for now, Zurmurwur passes on instructions from High Luminary Gurfurlur─the elector for the Feat of Proof. The challenge requires you locate the elector himself, hidden as he is somewhere within Urqopacha's vast mountain range...
TEXT_KINGMB110_04889_SEQ_06: Rather than simply rush off into the mountains in search of Gurfurlur, it is decided that gathering hints from the villagers is the wiser course. For her part, Wuk Lamat muses over the threat Valigarmanda represents, and wonders what might be done should the creature ever break free.
TEXT_KINGMB111_04890_SEQ_00: Alphinaud would share his strategy for information gathering.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat gazes up at the summit of Worqor Zormor.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_SEQ_01:
As you prepare to ascend the mountain, you are accosted by a hostile group of Yok Huy. Their leader proclaims his brethren the rightful overlords of Tural, and makes clear his intent to reignite their campaign of conquest with the death of the Third Promise. Before he can act on his threat, however, a monstrous bird swoops down to attack one of his men. Wuk Lamat springs into action, defending the giant from certain death, and befuddling her erstwhile antagonist with her reasons for doing so.

Leaving Alphinaud behind to tend to the injured─and the giants to puzzle over Wuk Lamat's unexpected behavior─you turn your attention back to the towering peak before you. Worqor Zormor looms impossibly high, yet if you are to reach the elector, what choice do you have but to start climbing...?

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_SEQ_02: Although the path is long and arduous, you eventually reach the summit of Worqor Zormor where the High Luminary awaits your arrival. Gurfurlur gives you no time to rest, immediately demanding that Wuk Lamat demonstrate her worth through combat. With you fighting at her side, the Third Promise endures the grueling battle until the enormous giant is at last forced to his knees.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_SEQ_03:
Gurfurlur commends Wuk Lamat on her martial prowess. The ensuing conversation turns to the origins of the legend of the golden city, only to be interrupted by the appearance of Koana and his Archon allies. The High Luminary once more issues his challenge and, at the culmination of the battle, awards keystones to both successful claimants.

Having arrived earlier, an impatient Zoraal Ja steps forth and demands to be shown Gulool Ja Ja's living sepulchre─a monument to those who stood against the terrifying Valigarmanda. Curiosity over the names etched upon the stone is overshadowed by confusion when an unholy screech suddenly rends the air. Your sense of foreboding is confirmed when Alphinaud calls and urges you to hurry back to Worlar's Echo. Valigarmanda, the Skyruin, has broken free.
TEXT_KINGMB112_04891_SEQ_04: Alphinaud describes a sudden surge in aether that drew him back to the village, but by the time he returned, all hells had broken loose. Before you can delve into the cause of this chaos, however, there are wounded to attend to.
TEXT_KINGMB113_04892_SEQ_00: Alphinaud would enlist your aid in checking on the injured Yok Huy.
TEXT_KINGMB114_04893_SEQ_00: Erenville is ready to send his aether-seeking device in pursuit of Valigarmanda.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SEQ_00: Erenville is ready to resume tracking Valigarmanda.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SEQ_01: Erenville has recalibrated the aether seeker to track Valigarmanda's unique aetheric signature. After beeping excitedly, the device speeds off into the distance, leaving you with little choice but to hurry on after it.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SEQ_02: The aether seeker leads you to another burning crater. Satisfied that the device is now locked onto the correct aetherial aspect, Erenville adjusts the threshold for aetheric concentration. With any luck, this change in parameters should allow you to follow the invisible trail of Valigarmanda itself.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SEQ_03: Your pursuit of the Skyruin pauses briefly outside the Indelible Passage. The seeker points forward, indicating your quarry must be somewhere on the other side of the tunnel ahead.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SEQ_04:
Though the aether trail comes to an end, Erenville is confident Valigarmanda is headed towards Worqor Lar Dor. You assemble your companions, but barely manage to take a step in the direction of the many-colored mountain when Vorporlor appears and forbids you from trespassing on their sacred site.

The standoff only intensifies when Wuk Lamat's brothers arrive to offer their assistance, and it takes an earnest reminder from one of Vorporlor's own underlings to persuade the giant to allow the hunting party to pass. Your numbers now bolstered by the First and Second Promise, you set forth to slay the thousand-year-old menace spoken of in fear and immortalized in stone─Valigarmanda, the Skyruin!

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SEQ_05: The battlefield heaves and cracks under an onslaught of raging fire, bone-chilling ice, and incandescent lightning. Yet you emerge from this maelstrom of elemental fury victorious─Valigarmanda, the legendary tural vidraal, is no more.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SEQ_06: Initially elated at besting the monster even her father could not slay, Wuk Lamat is soon sobered by Koana's more realistic appraisal of your accomplishment. A few carefully chosen words from you, however, soon have the Third Promise resolving to surpass her old man in the future. Exhausted yet triumphant, the party heads off to reunite with the waiting Erenville.
TEXT_KINGMB115_04894_SEQ_07: Stoic as ever, Erenville betrays no surprise at your success against the Skyruin. As for the First Promise, the gleaner claims that Zoraal Ja seemed disinclined to linger for any celebrations of your victory.
TEXT_KINGMB116_04895_SEQ_00: Thancred would suggest sharing the news of your victory.
TEXT_KINGMB117_04896_SEQ_00: Erenville would propose a course of action.
TEXT_KINGMC101_04897_SEQ_00: Alphinaud seems eager to review your journey thus far.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat's attention is divided between the perilously deep cenote and Iq Br'aax.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_SEQ_01: You arrive in the Garden of the Stars to discover the other claimants waiting for you in varying degrees of impatience. The gentle villager who welcomed you to Iq Br'aax is none other than Hunmu Rruk, leader of the Xbr'aal people and elector for the rite of succession. He presents the objective for the Feat of Repast: replicating a traditional dish called xibruq pibil. Unlike previous feats, claimants are divided into two teams, with Wuk Lamat and Koana mercifully paired by lots. As only the winning team will receive keystones, Koana is eager to discuss strategy...
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_SEQ_02: Lacking a proper recipe or general knowledge of xibruq pibil, your group splits up to gather information around the village. Whether the villagers will be forthcoming with guidance remains to be seen.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_SEQ_03: Despite the lack of explicit instruction, you were able to glean enough about xibruq pibil to get started. It is time to return to the Garden of the Stars and share your findings with the others.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_SEQ_04: After piecing together a recipe and list of ingredients, your group once more divides its forces to procure what you require. Koana is on a quest for Ja Tiika banana leaves and would have you accompany him and his sister.
TEXT_KINGMC102_04898_SEQ_05: Wuk Lamat is eager to obtain the najool leaves you require so she may sooner partake of new culinary delights. Far be it from you to deny a hungry Promise.
TEXT_KINGMC103_04899_SEQ_00: Koana has the look of a man intent on finding bananas.
TEXT_KINGMC104_04900_SEQ_00: Bananas still weigh heavily upon Koana's mind.
TEXT_KINGMC105_04901_SEQ_00: The next feat awaits, and Alphinaud would have you on the road as soon as possible.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SEQ_00: Hunmu Rruk stands quietly, his expression one of old pain.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SEQ_01: After divulging the truth of his relation to Wuk Lamat, Hunmu Rruk requests a moment to compose himself. You return to the Garden of the Stars, leaving the Xbr'aax Rax alone with his thoughts.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SEQ_02: No sooner do you rejoin Wuk Lamat than one of Bakool Ja Ja's minions arrives to escort Wuk Lamat to an undisclosed location for purposes unknown. Whatever it is, it cannot be good, so Wuk Lamat answers this summons with you as her second. Thus are you led to the Xobr'it Cinderfield, where you discover that a swaggering Bakool Ja Ja holds hostage Hunmu Rruk─whom he exposes as Wuk Lamat's birth father. The elector's release is contingent upon Wuk Lamat placing her keystones on the line and triumphing over Bakool Ja Ja in single combat. All you can do is trust in your friend as she attempts to settle the score with her tormentor once and for all...
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SEQ_03:
Bakool Ja Ja brings to bear the full wrath of blessed siblings, but to little effect. Unable to tolerate the impending defeat of their fearless leader, lackeys and bandits who have tied their fate to the two-headed claimant join the fray─yet Wuk Lamat stands firm. Out of options and out of strength, Bakool Ja Ja flees into the forest, abandoning his prisoner.

Before Wuk Lamat can confirm the truth of her heritage, Hunmu Rruk diverts the conversation, praising her strength as Gulool Ja Ja's daughter. His eyes bespeak a kindness and resolution to leave other words unsaid, which Wuk Lamat no doubt sees as well. Though you cannot know her heart, her smile says enough.
TEXT_KINGMC106_04902_SEQ_04: Wuk Lamat has proven to both herself and the world that even when forced to stand alone, she is capable of protecting what is precious to her. Whatever the final feat demands, it is clear that she can rise to the occasion.
TEXT_KINGMC107_04903_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat wishes to know how traversable the Ty'iinbek Traverse is.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SEQ_00: Finally in Mamook, Wuk Lamat is eager to make progress.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SEQ_01: In the interest of time and safety, your group splits into pairs to search for the elector. You can only hope the people's reception of outsiders is not as bad as Hunmu Rruk predicted...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SEQ_02: You are staunchly ignored and avoided by the citizens you attempt to speak to. Perhaps Wuk Lamat fared better.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SEQ_03: Wuk Lamat's experience was strikingly similar to your own. However, she spots what looks like a market nearby─and those endeavoring to earn coin may be more inclined to lend an ear.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SEQ_04:
You are called away from another fruitless attempt at communication by Alphinaud, who urges everyone to join him with all haste. You arrive in time to watch Zoraal Ja bend knee to a hulking shadow of his father─a shade which subsequently vanishes into smoke, revealing the elector of Mamook, Zereel Ja. The elector chastises the First Promise for attempting to obtain the keystone by force after being bested in battle, and for this violation, he is disqualified from the rite of succession.

Zoraal Ja has no sooner left the stage than Bakool Ja Ja arrives, a homecoming that turns sour in an instant. When he discovers Bakool Ja Ja has not only failed to make progress in the rite, but suffered defeat at the hands of Wuk Lamat, Zereel Ja banishes him, casting aside his own son as he might a broken tool. The elector of Mamook then turns his gaze to the remaining claimants, whom he is eager to engage in the Feat of the Brotherhood, an ultimate test of strength against the most formidable of blessed siblings─a foe he is confident they will be unable to overcome. Wuk Lamat refuses, however, stating that she must learn more about Mamook first. Hearing this, the woman standing beside Zereel Ja approaches Wuk Lamat and whispers that she wishes to speak in private...
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SEQ_05: As no locals have shown any inclination towards speaking with outsiders thus far, the woman who left with Zereel Ja may be your only opportunity to learn anything substantial about Mamook. Wuk Lamat sets out to meet her west of the city as requested.
TEXT_KINGMC108_04904_SEQ_06: The woman introduces herself as Miilal Ja, and explains that Mamook has become a cloister for devotees of blessed siblings. Only two-headed Mamool Ja are worthy of ruling Tuliyollal─or so they fervently believe. But Miilal Ja and others reject this tradition, and want nothing more than to convince their brethren of its senselessness. But what is the terrible price they have paid for their zealotry which has moved her to seek your aid?
TEXT_KINGMC109_04905_SEQ_00: Miilal Ja has something to show you.
TEXT_KINGMC110_04906_SEQ_00: Alphinaud is ready to bring the people together.
TEXT_KINGMC111_04907_SEQ_00: Before she hears the people, Wuk Lamat would like to ensure she is prepared.
TEXT_KINGMC112_04908_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is determined to find a solution for Mamook.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_00: Ketenramm, living legend and Eorzean explorer extraordinaire, would like to chat.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_01: Ketenramm has invited you and your comrades to his home, which is situated nearby. You cannot help but consider the subtle shade of his irises on your way to the Blue-eyes' Abode...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_02: In speaking with her father's old friend, Wuk Lamat discovers some parallels between Ketenramm's bond with Gulool Ja Ja and her own with the Scions. Comrades are precious indeed─especially when they can deduce the location of the golden prize one seeks. Krile shares her growing suspicion that the legendary city may be located in the forests of Yak T'el, and thus the group resolves to ask the now cordial citizens for information while replenishing their traveling supplies.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_03: According to Erenville, Ketenramm and his mentor are acquaintances, but the gleaner is as reserved as ever when it comes to sharing details about his personal life. He excuses himself to go and meet the others by the aetheryte.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_04: Resupplied yet still bereft of clues, your group reassembles. Luckily, Miilal Ja would repay your kindness to her community by divulging all she knows about the golden city while Zereel Ja pointedly turns a blind eye. All parts of the Ja Tiika Heartland have been thoroughly charted except for the Skydeep Cenote, the final resting place of countless young lives lost. Comparing Miilal Ja's testimony with those of Hunmu Rruk and Vorporlor, it seems all but certain that you have at last discovered the city's location. With Bakool Ja Ja's blessed scale in hand, you set forth to Gok Draak Descent...
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_05:
The doors of the cenotaph loom above you and the air is thick with the smell of earth, water, and age. Your group offers prayers to the souls of the departed before doing what you must to see the rite of succession to its end.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_06:
In the deepest recesses of the cenote, you come upon a grand door, locked with what Krile recognizes as a Sharlayan seal. When Wuk Lamat places her completed tablets upon the provided pedestal, the door opens, revealing an extraordinary room. Black stone and glowing lights seem almost Allagan at first, but their differences quickly outnumber the similarities.

A gate stands dormant at the far end of the room─but before anyone can comment on it, the Dawnservant's booming laugh announces his arrival. Further discussion of this latest mystery is set aside for the time being, as the impending celebration demands everyone's attention. Wuk Lamat has discovered the entrance to the city of gold and successfully completed the rite of succession.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_07: Though your questions far outweigh whatever answers you gleaned about the golden city, they will have to wait. For now, your group heads back to Tuliyollal for some well-deserved rest and to celebrate Wuk Lamat's achievements.
TEXT_KINGMC113_04909_SEQ_08: Wuk Lamat has gone ahead to the palace to prepare for her ascension ceremony. In the meantime, your haggard-yet-happy group of friends seem ready for a bath and a nap.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SEQ_01: As you recount the more dramatic points of the ascension ceremony, Wuk Lamat comes to join you. A well-intentioned “Dawnservant” later, and she reminds you of how little she enjoys titles. You and your comrades are like unto family, she says, and as such, should call her “Lamaty'i.” Swept up in the happy moment, Wuk Lamat invites you to accompany her as she thanks her supporters gathered in the city.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SEQ_02:
First on the list of supporters to meet with are Wuk Evu and Mablu, who were spotted at Aunt Tii's Tacos. Wuk Lamat insists she has not prioritized them for purposes of acquiring celebratory snacks, but whether this proves true remains to be seen.

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SEQ_03:
You find Wuk Evu, Mablu, Tobli, and Linuhanu in good spirits and enjoying the finest tacos in Tuliyollal. Mablu and Tobli provide updates from Urqopacha from alpaca health to commemorative discounts, whilst Linuhanu reminds Wuk Lamat of her promise to attend Ihih'hana. Wuk Evu, predictably flustered by Wuk Lamat's new title, eventually settles down long enough to offer his services as a tutor regarding the cultures and customs of communities in Xak Tural.

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SEQ_04:
You come upon two Yok Huy, a Moblin, and an Elezen artisan in Bayside Bevy─an eclectic group of familiar faces. Wuk Lamat echoes the promises she made in her ascension speech to Gurfurlur and Zurmurwur regarding the Chirwagur, and while they predict change will take time, they are nevertheless optimistic. Meanwhile, Rakorok chats animatedly about cooperation and Fonjeantaine seems to have found inner peace.

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SEQ_05:
Hunmu Rruk, Zereel Ja, and Miilal Ja are gathered on the Gornitruq Gleamsands. The Xbr'aax Rax congratulates Wuk Lamat with all due formality, but there is no concealing the pride in his eyes. With an apologetic smile, Miilal Ja explains that Bakool Ja Ja left early, unready to face his new Dawnservant. Just as notably absent is Ketenramm, though it is noted that he has always been somewhat mercurial in his appearances.

Having spoken to everyone she could, Wuk Lamat suggests the two of you head back to the Winged Walk.

※You must be accompanied by Wuk Lamat to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SEQ_06: After a journey that spanned an ocean and half a continent, Wuk Lamat has defied the odds and become Dawnservant of Tuliyollal. She would have you remain by her side in an official capacity to help guide the nation into a brighter future─but adventurers are not wont to linger in a single place for long, and you have yet to explore the northern reaches of Tural...
TEXT_KINGMC115_04911_SEQ_07: So it is that you bid farewell to your other traveling companions and join Erenville at the Xak Tural skygate. What adventures wait for you beyond, only time will tell.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_SEQ_00: Erenville is ready to set off.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_SEQ_01: For you and Erenville, the time has come to embark on a new adventure in the northern reaches of Tural. To that end, the gleaner bids you speak with the sentry standing near the gate leading out of the city. Once you show him your travel pass, you can be on your way.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_SEQ_02: You present your travel pass to the sentry, who proceeds to open the gates and grant you and Erenville passage to Xak Tural. On the other side of the great bridge you find arid wilds stretching out before you. Thus do you begin your journey into Shaaloani with Erenville as your guide.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_SEQ_03: Erenville believes traveling by train will be the swiftest way to reach his home, Yyasulani, and he suggests riding rroneek to the station. Thankfully, there is a stable nearby where you should be able to secure mounts.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_SEQ_04: The stablekeep regretfully informs you that he does not have rroneek to spare for your trip. At least, not at present. He wishes to see you safely to your destination, and so he asks that you wait a short while until he can prepare mounts for the both of you. To pass the intervening time, Erenville suggests going to the nearby town of Hhusatahwi.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_SEQ_05: No sooner do you enter town than the commotion from a nearby tavern draws your attention. Two men step outside, one chasing after the other, and their heated exchange seems likely to escalate into violence until the timely intervention of a familiar bystander, Estinien. You and the dragoon exchange pleasantries, but he departs as quickly as he arrived, leaving you and Erenville to reflect upon recent events.
TEXT_KINGMD101_04912_SEQ_06: As Erenville explains it, Shaaloani was once a lawless place where differences were often resolved through duels. To preserve the peace without having to resort to conflict, the Dustwatch was founded, likely at the behest of those who share in Koana's vision of a modern Tural. Knowing your history of solving problems through strength of arms, Erenville urges you to remain on your best behavior, lest you find yourself in one of their jails.
TEXT_KINGMD102_04913_SEQ_00: Erenville would not dither about for long.
TEXT_KINGMD103_04914_SEQ_00: Erenville's composed demeanor belies his eagerness to help Namikka.
TEXT_KINGMD104_04915_SEQ_00: Erenville's gaze is fixed on the bandits' hideout.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SEQ_01: Unbeknownst to the people of Sheshenewezi Springs, ceruleum barrels there are being packed with stolen goods to be shipped away and sold elsewhere. Wihuwte, the deputy chief of the Dustwatch, is both the leader of the bandits and the mastermind behind this scheme. To bring him to justice, Zekowa proposes that two of you lure Wihuwte away to Hhusatahwi while the third remains to find these barrels. Erenville volunteers to stay and search, leaving you and Zekowa to keep Wihuwte occupied.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SEQ_02: You approach Wihuwte, but he appears to be lost in thought. As he seems utterly determined to ignore you, perhaps a gentle /poke will get his attention.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SEQ_03:
Having gotten Wihuwte to acknowledge your existence, you proceed to tell him that Zekowa attempted to rob you, but that you managed to subdue and capture him. While he appears slightly skeptical, he is nevertheless eager to follow you so he can tie up this loose end.

※You must be accompanied by Wihuwte to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SEQ_04:
You lead Wihuwte a ways into the desert. After coming to a stop, Wihuwte looks to you expectantly, but you claim to have misremembered where you left Zekowa. Not one to be deterred, the deputy chief bids you continue.

※You must be accompanied by Wihuwte to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SEQ_05:
You stop at another clearing, and again offer an excuse for why Zekowa is nowhere to be found. Wihuwte is clearly annoyed, but he asks you to keep going.

※You must be accompanied by Wihuwte to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SEQ_06:
Wihuwte's patience is wearing thin by the time you pause yet again to get your bearings. He warns you that if Zekowa is not at your next destination, he may be forced to do something you both regret.

※You must be accompanied by Wihuwte to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SEQ_07: Wihuwte is seething, but before he can make good on his earlier threat, he is distracted by yelling nearby. He follows the voice a short distance to find a grinning Zekowa, who leads the deputy chief on a merry chase that ends back in Hhusatahwi. He prepares to arrest Zekowa, but in that moment Erenville arrives with a barrel full of the townsfolk's stolen possessions, and subsequently reveals the existence of the bandit's operation to a growing crowd. Accusing the deputy chief of being behind this criminal enterprise, Zekowa challenges Wihuwte to a duel, who is forced to accept. The ensuing altercation is over in the blink of an eye, and Wihuwte falls to the ground defeated.
TEXT_KINGMD105_04916_SEQ_08: Wihuwte has been arrested, and Zekowa's friends are freed from jail. Thanks to you and Erenville, it would seem everything in Sheshenewezi Springs has at last been put to rights.
TEXT_KINGMD106_04917_SEQ_00: Erenville is relieved to see everything set to rights.
TEXT_KINGMD107_04918_SEQ_00: Erenville is eager to be off to the Pyariyoanaan Plain.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SEQ_00: Erenville regards the pile of timber with undisguised weariness.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SEQ_01: Rather than remain idle, Erenville suggests moving the timber somewhere more easily accessible. You brace your back and prepare for a little heavy lifting.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SEQ_02: With a heave and a ho, you take up a crate full to bursting with timber. Thankfully the main road is not terribly far.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SEQ_03: No sooner do you set down the last of the timber than Wawlika arrives with Shenza, Zawpya, and a rroneek in tow. They insist you go and wait at the train station while they see to the timber's delivery.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SEQ_04: Erenville welcomes you back to the station, hopeful that you have had your fill of the sights of Shaaloani. He invites you to wait with him and watch the train as it departs.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SEQ_05:
The skies over Shaaloani suddenly grow dark, and with a thunderous boom a giant dome appears in the distance. A moment later, flying warships emerge from its murky depths, and upon realizing that they are heading for Tuliyollal, you and Erenville hasten back to the capital. You arrive in a city embroiled in chaos, with mysterious soldiers in the streets slaughtering innocents seemingly at random. Once reunited with Wuk Lamat, the Dawnservant explains that the enemy forces appeared out of nowhere and attacked without provocation. Together with Erenville, the three of you make your way towards the palace, and there find Gulool Ja Ja locked in mortal combat with a transformed Zoraal Ja. The hardened warrior proves no match for his father, but through the use of an unknown power, he not only revives himself, but manages to deal Gulool Ja Ja a fatal blow.

※In the event that you leave the area and wish to return, speak with the Landsguard gatekeeper at the entrance to Sunperch.
TEXT_KINGMD108_04919_SEQ_06: A hush falls over the throne room as all present realize Gulool Ja Ja is moments from his end. It remains to be seen if aught can be done to save the former Dawnservant...
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is struggling to process what she has witnessed.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_01:
The sun has set on the former Dawnservant Gulool Ja Ja. Unfortunately, there is no time to remain idle─the people of Tuliyollal have need of their new leaders.

※In the event that you leave the area and wish to return, speak with the Landsguard gatekeeper at the entrance to Sunperch.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_02: Wuk Lamat wishes to render aid to the people of Tuliyollal, and the Scions readily offer their assistance. She assigns them all to various places about the city in the hopes of attending to as many wounded as possible. As for you, she asks that you accompany her to the Resplendent Quarter.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_03: You have aided what people you can in the Resplendent Quarter, but there is yet more work to be done. Perhaps Wuk Lamat has an idea of where else your help may be needed.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_04: Not wishing to waste any time, Wuk Lamat asks that you make for Talonmarch. Your task is to assess what damage has been done to the area, after which you can reconvene with Alisaie at Bayside Bevy.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_05: You have a look about Talonmarch, and while there are parts that remain unscathed, the same cannot be said for what has become of Bayside Bevy. With your assessment complete, you seek out Alisaie.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_06: Alisaie has done what she can for the people of Bayside Bevy, and based on what little damage has been done to the buildings, she is convinced Zoraal Ja's attack was a display of force and not intended to inflict significant harm. Putting his motives aside, she is more concerned for Wuk Lamat, and asks that you return to check on her. Word has it she was last seen near the Gornitruq Gleamsands.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_07: You find Wuk Lamat alone, overcome with shock. You offer her what words of comfort you can, and though her heart yet aches, she finds the determination to press on.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_08: Wuk Lamat has newfound resolve to strike down Zoraal Ja and secure the peace and safety of Tural. She prepares to return to the place and speak with Koana to plan their next move, bidding you and the Scions join them.
TEXT_KINGMD109_04920_SEQ_09: Alisaie is relieved to hear Wuk Lamat is doing better. There can be no doubt the Scions will do all in their power to assist the new Dawnservants, but she cannot shake the uneasy feeling brought on by this unprecedented threat.
TEXT_KINGMD110_04921_SEQ_00: Alisaie regards the fallen soldier thoughtfully.
TEXT_KINGMD111_04922_SEQ_00: Before investigating the dome, Wuk Lamat wishes to see to one important matter.
TEXT_KINGMD112_04923_SEQ_00: Alphinaud is considering how best to help carry out Wuk Lamat's plan.
TEXT_KINGMD113_04924_SEQ_00: Your plan is set, but G'raha Tia is not without reservations.
TEXT_KINGMD114_04925_SEQ_00: A way to obtain fire crystals is on the tip of Iyaate's tongue.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SEQ_00: Despite his fatigue, there is an undeniable air of satisfaction about Wawlika.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SEQ_01: Wawlika and the other engineers are resolved to keep working without cease until modifications of the train have been completed. He suggests you see to any final preparations before they finish.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SEQ_02: With the Dawnblazer complete, you and your comrades hop aboard and set out for the dome. The train's fortifications and weaponry are soon put to the test when soldiers on flying vehicles descend upon you. Despite their best efforts, however, they fail to stop the train. Shortly before reaching its final destination, you all jump off and watch as the Dawnblazer crashes into Zoraal Ja's base.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SEQ_03:
Your plan was a success, as the train has torn a gaping hole in the wall of the stronghold. Not wishing to afford the enemy time to regroup, you make ready to rush inside, bracing yourself for the dangers that await. 

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SEQ_04: Together with your comrades, you brave a mechanical maze filled with sentries, its myriad defenses all failing to halt your advance. At its heart you find the base's commanding officer, who employs strange powers not unlike Zoraal Ja's to oppose you. After overcoming this final threat, you at last find an exit leading out into Yyasulani.
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SEQ_05: Emerging from the stronghold, your sense of relief quickly gives way to dread and uncertainty. What greets you are leaden skies and a bizarre landscape filled with otherworldly constructs...
TEXT_KINGMD115_04926_SEQ_06: Erenville's home has undergone a harrowing transformation, leaving him at a loss for words. If this is indeed Yyasulani, what is the reason for its current state?
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_00: Erenville looks upon Yyasulani in disbelief.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_01: You and the others struggle to make sense of what you see as you take in the dreary surroundings. Idle speculation will lead nowhere, however, and so you press on in search of clues that might explain what has befallen Erenville's home.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_02: Surveying the area, you spy what looks like a train station in the distance. Surmising it to be Yyasulani Station, you head in that direction, hoping to find passengers from the train nearby.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_03: Though you know for a fact that the train passed through here quite recently, the station appears to have not been used in decades. Wuk Lamat suggests having a look around for anything that might help make sense of the situation.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_04: A closer examination of the buildings and train tracks lends further support to the possibility that the train station has been unattended for many long years. Perhaps Wuk Lamat has fared better in discovering anything of note.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_05: Wuk Lamat calls the group's attention to a broken sentry similar to the soldiers that attacked Tuliyollal. While this all but confirms that Zoraal Ja holds control over the area, it fails to explain what has happened to Yyasulani. Its ruinous state suggests time has somehow leapt forward, but you have yet to find anything that might explain such a phenomenon. To be absolutely certain of where you are, Wuk Lamat asks Erenville to take you all to his home, and so the group sets off. All except G'raha Tia, whose attention is drawn to peculiar structures nearby.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_06: G'raha Tia could not help but notice pole-shaped structures in the distance that appear to function as lightning rods. He moves in for a closer look, and you follow after him.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_07: Upon closer inspection, G'raha Tia surmises the beacon-like structures are used to harness lightning as a source of energy─though it remains to be seen what that energy is used for. His curiosity sated, the two of you go and rejoin the others.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_08:
Erenville's home is in ruins, the village seemingly abandoned. A sullen silence falls over the group, which is immediately broken by the appearance of a stranger in even stranger garb. She welcomes you to what she calls Alexandria and introduces herself as Sphene, the Queen of Reason. Zoraal Ja rules alongside her as king, but she claims the two are at odds. In fact, she begs your aid in stopping him.

Talking with Sphene further, you reach the conclusion that two worlds have somehow become one within the confines of the dome, though the catalyst for this phenomenon is not immediately clear. Hoping to show you more of Alexandria, and perhaps shed more light on how this joining occurred, she invites you to a place she calls the outskirts.
TEXT_KINGMD116_04927_SEQ_09: Sphene is all smiles as she leads the group to the outskirts, but Alisaie believes that there is more to the queen than meets the eye. Only time will tell if she is truly friend or foe.
TEXT_KINGMD117_04928_SEQ_00: Alisaie is inclined to keep a close eye on the queen.
TEXT_KINGMD118_04929_SEQ_00: Sphene is eager to show you around.
TEXT_KINGMD119_04930_SEQ_00: Sphene would take you back to the outskirts.
TEXT_KINGMD120_04931_SEQ_00: Erenville is conflicted by this long-fated reunion.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_SEQ_00: Cahciua regards you with concerned curiosity.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_SEQ_01: Having given you an overview of the usage of souls in Alexandria, Cahciua bids you return to her group's hideout in Earthen Sky. But before you do so, Wuk Lamat wishes to have a discussion with your party, and so you gather by the tunnel entrance.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_SEQ_02: Wuk Lamat proposes cooperating with Oblivion, that you might obtain the intelligence you need to contend with the enemy. While Erenville is wary of doing so, saying that it may not be his mother behind the machine, the rest of your party is willing to take the risk. The decision thus made, you all make your way into the tunnel to join your prospective collaborators.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_SEQ_03: When Wuk Lamat pleads her case to Cahciua, it quickly transpires that the desire to work together is very much mutual. So it is that you join hands with Oblivion, and immediately begin making plans to draw Zoraal Ja out of hiding. Knowing his deep-seated yearning to surpass their father, Wuk Lamat suggests striking at him when he grows weary of waiting and instead moves to invade Tuliyollal again. Until that time, you must prepare for battle by learning about the technology that empowers your foe. To that end, Cahciua offers to show you to Oblivion's main headquarters inside Everkeep, but first you turn your attention to Geode, who wishes to introduce his crew.
TEXT_KINGME101_04932_SEQ_04: In addition to Geode himself, you are introduced to the twins Nostalgia and Wayakkwe, who share their tragic motive for joining the fight against Zoraal Ja. It appears the Mamool Ja has done little to endear himself to the people of Alexandria since becoming their ruler...
TEXT_KINGME102_04933_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is eager to head to Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_00: Sphene stands ready to take you on a tour of Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_01: After finding you in Solution Nine, Sphene agrees to take you on a tour, and begins by showing you the Nexus Arcade. Of particular note, you learn about the properties and applications of electrope, the miraculous ore which is used in virtually all things in Alexandria. After making a passing comment on what having such a material could mean in their world, a shop catches Wuk Lamat's eye.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_02: The shop in question sells various foodstuffs, and Sphene purchases an item each for you and Wuk Lamat to try. This becomes something of an event as a curious crowd soon gathers to observe newcomers sample Alexandrian cuisine for the first time. You and Wuk Lamat duly partake of your selections, thus nourishing yourselves even as you delight the citizens.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_03: Seeing that you are satisfied, Sphene next offers to take you to the residential sector, in part for personal business. At your word, she will lead you in the direction of your destination.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_04:
You begin making your way to the residential sector with Sphene and Wuk Lamat. Should you come upon any places of interest en route, your guide would be glad to tell you about them.

※You must be accompanied by Sphene and Wuk Lamat to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_05:
Stopping before a café called Mosaic, Sphene explains the name as being a reference to the myriad races that inhabit the continent. Wuk Lamat takes the opportunity to mention one of her favorite dishes, tacos, before you continue on your way.

※You must be accompanied by Sphene and Wuk Lamat to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_06:
Upon arriving at the residential sector, Sphene explains that she is here to visit some people. Their apartment is located in the left building of residential radius 9-14, and you proceed through the entrance.

※You must be accompanied by Sphene and Wuk Lamat to complete this task. Speak with either of them again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_07: You enter the apartment to meet the occupants, a woman and her infirm son. The boy is revealed to suffer from levin sickness, a debilitating disease caused by the pervasion of ambient lightning. The condition is common among children born inside the dome, but thus far no cure has been found, with soul technology ineffective against old age and illness. Seemingly overwhelmed, Sphene cuts her visit short and heads back outside.
TEXT_KINGME103_04934_SEQ_08: Sphene thanks you for accompanying her, and explains that she wished for you to know about this aspect of life in Alexandria. She expresses her desire to find a cure, that the children need no longer suffer, and you take her resolve to heart as you look to learn more about her nation.
TEXT_KINGME104_04935_SEQ_00: Having recomposed herself, Sphene is ready to continue the tour.
TEXT_KINGME105_04936_SEQ_00: Having seen the district to her satisfaction, Wuk Lamat is ready to head to the meeting point.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SEQ_00: Tassos stands stoically before the door.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SEQ_01:
After a quick word with Tassos, you are shown through to the Backroom, the headquarters of Oblivion. There, Cahciua, Shale, and Genolt provide you with an overview of their operations, which include investigating Preservation, an organization credited with developing interdimensional fusion─the power which brought Alexandria to Tural. In the course of the conversation, Shale recognizes Krile's earring to be a data storage device. The manner in which Krile and the accessory arrived in the Source leads to speculation that her parents may in fact be the founders of Oblivion, and she is given permission to review data in the Backroom. While your other comrades are then engaged in various ways, you find yourself roped into lending Genolt a hand. Even now, he regards you with his unsettlingly familiar grin in anticipation of your aid...

※In the event that you leave the Backroom, you may re-enter by speaking with Tassos at the Neon Stein.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SEQ_02: Severely sleep-deprived but determined to do his work, Genolt tasks you with fetching his favorite energy tonic. He hands you vouchers that can be exchanged for two cans─one for him and one for you─which you are to collect from a man named Philomon on the main strip of True Vue.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SEQ_03: Upon finding Philomon, you are taken aback when he angrily denies selling energy tonics. His tone quickly changes, however, as he leans in and quietly tells you to give him the voucher.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SEQ_04: Philomon hands you the cans of energy tonic, with yours apparently formulated for beginners. This being your first time, he requires that you drink it in his presence in case there are side effects.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SEQ_05: You drink the energy tonic and experience transcendent alertness, all with seemingly no adverse effects. Satisfied that all is well, Philomon bids you return to the Backroom to deliver Genolt his tonic.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SEQ_06: No sooner do you put the tonic into Genolt's hand than he drains it in one pull. The effect is immediate and intense, and the man resumes his work with newfound vigor. Having completed your little errand, you turn to join Wuk Lamat in conversation with Cahciua.
TEXT_KINGME106_04937_SEQ_07: Cahciua confirms your suspicions: the blue-scaled Hoobigo child is most certainly Zoraal Ja's son. Named Gulool Ja by Cahciua after she found him, he was abandoned at an early age and prefers to be on his own. As his aunt, Wuk Lamat expresses her desire to take him in, but when she mentions her objective of killing his father, you are alerted to the sound of fleeing footfalls. To everyone's dismay, it appears that Gulool Ja was eavesdropping. Desperate to explain herself to her nephew, Wuk Lamat will set out to find him, and you and Alisaie will help search outside Everkeep.
TEXT_KINGME107_04938_SEQ_00: It is all Wuk Lamat can do not to rush off after Gulool Ja.
TEXT_KINGME108_04939_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is eager to follow Gulool Ja into the ruined town.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_SEQ_00: Otis is pleased with the meat you have brought him.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_SEQ_01: Having taken receipt of your meat, Otis next asks you to procure kindling electrope. To that end, you head over to the houses nearby to gather pieces of electrope, some of which should be the variety you require.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_SEQ_02: After a rummage through the ruins, you manage to gather a decent amount of electrope pieces. As per Otis's instructions, you bear them to Gulool Ja for identification.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_SEQ_03: As you watch on, Gulool Ja examines the electrope pieces and soon identifies the one you require. Having duly finished your task, you go to report to Otis.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_SEQ_04: With the preparations complete, Otis cooks up the promised repast and serves it up for all to enjoy. As you relax afterwards, your bellies full of delicious stew, Wuk Lamat has a candid conversation with Gulool Ja and tells him what it means to be family. At Alisaie's urging, Otis then shares with you his tale. Centuries ago, before lightning had changed the world, he was an ordinary man who served as a knight of Alexandria. When the great calamity struck, the king and queen passed away, and their only daughter the princess was taken by illness not long after ascending the throne. Through the power of electrope, however, her soul and memories were preserved, and she was spared eternal death. This procedure was made possible by none other than Otis, who volunteered as a test subject, resulting in his transformation into the machine he is now. Those that are thus recreated from the memories of the departed are known as the Endless, and to everyone's shock, it is revealed that Sphene was the first of them─the queen who was brought back to life.
TEXT_KINGME109_04940_SEQ_05: As you and your companions struggle to process the revelation of Sphene's true nature, questions arise over whether Cahciua and her people had been aware of this fact. For all that you have learned, it seems there is still much and more that you do not know...
TEXT_KINGME110_04941_SEQ_00: Otis looks pleased with himself, insofar as his vessel can indicate.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat has a request to make before setting off to confront Zoraal Ja.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SEQ_01:
Zoraal Ja is on the move once more, marching on Vanguard ahead of a second invasion of Tuliyollal, and you accompany Wuk Lamat as she confronts her brother. As their duel unfolds, the King of Resolve reveals that it is in fact the Queen of Reason who has orchestrated the attacks in order to plunder life force for her people. When Sphene personally appears to confirm the disturbing claim, Zoraal Ja unceremoniously cuts her down, thereby exposing that she is an illusion projected upon a mechanical soldier.

As the battle continues to unfold, Wuk Lamat divests Zoraal Ja of his advantage by destroying his regulator, but he responds by unleashing his war fleet on Tuliyollal. However, his forces are ultimately repelled, prompting him to take drastic measures. Having cut down his own aide for another regulator, he gives the order for all civilians in Everkeep to be executed for their souls, leaving Sphene horrified. It is at that moment that Gulool Ja unexpectedly appears to plead with his father, but Zoraal Ja takes him hostage and places Otis under his thrall. The king then flees, but not before challenging Wuk Lamat to come to the summit of Everkeep, there to settle matters once and for all.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SEQ_02: Knowing that her brother cares not for others' lives, Wuk Lamat fears the worst for the civilians. So it is that you hasten back to Everkeep, braced for a grueling struggle with Zoraal Ja's mechanical army.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SEQ_03: Upon entering Solution Nine, you are greeted with scenes of unspeakable carnage as mechanical soldiers carry out their orders with cold efficiency. In spite of Sphene's crimes, Wuk Lamat offers to help her protect her people, and together you make your way through the district to deal with rampant machines and fiends alike. At length you encounter Otis, who remains under Zoraal Ja's control, and are forced to fight him. Sphene's fervent plea awakens the old knight just in time for him to save her from a marauding fiend, and together you succeed in defeating your fearsome foe. Sadly, the exertion proves too much for Otis's aging frame and he ceases to function, having valiantly protected his queen.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SEQ_04: Thanks to your intervention, the carnage has been brought to an end with Solution Nine being spared the worst. Cahciua asks that you help treat the wounded, and you and your comrades regroup in preparation for the relief effort.
TEXT_KINGME111_04942_SEQ_05: Wuk Lamat cannot hide her fury at Zoraal Ja for slaughtering his own citizens, nor her confusion as to why he would commit such an atrocity. But now is not the time to ponder such questions, for there are people in need of help.
TEXT_KINGME112_04943_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat wishes to do what she can for the people of Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGME113_04944_SEQ_00: Cahciua wishes to hold a strategy meeting.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_00: Cahciua wishes to take you to the entrance of Origenics.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_01: Having tended to the aftermath of the massacre in Solution Nine, you and your allies now look to dealing with Zoraal Ja. In order to reach the summit of Everkeep where he awaits, you must climb your way through Origenics, the facility where souls are separated and refined for use. To that end, you follow Cahciua to your departure point at the driftdowns.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_02:
At the pier, Cahciua explains how the mission will unfold. When Origenics takes a scheduled delivery, you will steal inside aboard a hover cargo, and thence fight your way upwards. As you await departure, you see to your final preparations in anticipation of the facility's tight security.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_03:
After an arduous climb that takes you past technology both extraordinary and disturbing, you finally arrive at the uppermost section of Origenics on Everkeep's eleventh floor. There you come upon a storage chamber for soul cells, but to your dismay, most are already spent of their contents─it would seem Zoraal Ja has wasted no time availing himself of their power. A sudden noise from behind causes alarm, but it quickly gives way to gladness as you make out the figures of Alphinaud, Y'shtola, and Estinien, who have entered the dome in order to lend you a hand. With your formidable crew thus assembled, you press onwards to the summit in search of Zoraal Ja.

※In the event that you leave the summit of Everkeep, you may return there by speaking with Kiluwsa at the driftdowns.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_04:
Ascending to the summit, instead of a twelfth level, you are shocked to find an enormous interdimensional portal hanging overhead in the open sky. Your immediate concern, however, is Zoraal Ja, who emerges from the blanket of clouds. A gasp escapes your lips when you see his tortured form, in the process of being twisted by the profusion of souls he has taken into himself. Wuk Lamat steps forward to challenge her brother, and thus begins the final battle between the siblings─between the Vow of Resolve of Tuliyollal and the King of Resolve of Alexandria─whose outcome will steer the course of the world...

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_05:
Despite completing his transformation into a transcendent being, Zoraal Ja ultimately falls before your determined onslaught. Having told a teary Gulool Ja that he is free to embrace or spurn his legacy, he then breathes his last. As Wuk Lamat laments her brother's path, Sphene arrives and reveals that she still intends to plunder aether from other worlds in order to sustain the Endless, whom she insists are not dead. She takes up the object the king left behind, the key to interdimensional fusion, and sends it through the portal before closing it. In that instant, she disappears, having left you with the fervent declaration that she will stop at nothing in order to save her subjects─even should it demand that she become history's most brutal queen.

※In the event that you leave the summit of Everkeep, you may return there by speaking with Kiluwsa at the driftdowns.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_06:
In place of roiling storm clouds, a clear and empty sky now hangs over Everkeep. As all present stand silent, processing events, you turn to Y'shtola for what insights she may be able to offer.

※In the event that you leave the summit of Everkeep, you may return there by speaking with Kiluwsa at the driftdowns.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_07:
Y'shtola posits that Sphene's true form exists in the reflection beyond the portal, but with it closed, you cannot go after her. Hoping to find clues, she suggests examining Cahciua's vessel, which has ceased to function.

※In the event that you leave the summit of Everkeep, you may return there by speaking with Kiluwsa at the driftdowns.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_08: Erenville reveals his suspicion that Cahciua is in fact an Endless. Given the timing of her vessel's deactivation, she is likely in the same reflection as Sphene, to which you must find a way to travel if you are to prevent the queen from enacting her genocidal plan. While Y'shtola leads an investigation at the tower's summit, you are urged to head back below with Wuk Lamat and Gulool Ja to get some rest.
TEXT_KINGME114_04945_SEQ_09: You join Wuk Lamat in the Backroom. She concedes to needing a rest, and having witnessed her exertions every step of the way, you are inclined to agree.
TEXT_KINGMF101_04946_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is searching for the words to say to Shale.
TEXT_KINGMF102_04947_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat wishes to look in on her soldiers.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is eager to set off for the Skydeep Cenote.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_01: It has been determined that the gate of the golden city likely leads to Sphene's home reflection. The Queen of Reason has all but certainly retreated there, and in order to find her and thwart her plot, you and your comrades set forth for the Skydeep Cenote.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_02: At the entrance to the cenote's inner chamber, Wuk Lamat cannot help but be struck by a pang of nostalgia for the journey thus far. The others join in sharing their feelings before you all proceed inside.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_03:
So it is that you come before the enigmatic gate to the golden city once more. You take your places as Krile prepares to see if her earring is indeed the key to lifting the seal. In conjunction with the authority Gulool Ja inherited from his late father, the earring serves to open the gate and reveal a portal to another reflection. With the way forward thus secured, it is decided that you, Wuk Lamat, Krile, G'raha Tia, and Erenville will be the ones to sally forth, and you gird yourselves as you regard the golden light into which you must step.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return via the inner chamber of the Skydeep Cenote.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_04: With the portal's protection entrusted to your companions, you sally forth unto the unknown reflection that Wuk Lamat has dubbed the unlost world.
