TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_05: Mere moments after entering the portal, you emerge on the other side. Your breath catches in your throat as the scenery comes into view─a sprawling, dazzling city that could only be described as the legend of the golden city come to life.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_06: Having composed yourselves after the initial awe, you set about exploring your surrounds. Wuk Lamat suggests following a nearby path to see where it leads.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_07: As you and your comrades observe that the city is likely Alexandrian, you are approached by an Endless named Constancy. Introducing himself as a guide, he explains that the city is called Living Memory, and it was originally a recreational attraction for ordinary people before being repurposed as a haven for Endless. When Wuk Lamat indicates your desire to see Sphene, he advises you to seek her out at the Meso Terminal at the center of the city.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_08: Sphene appears upon being called at the Meso Terminal, and Wuk Lamat pleads for her to reconsider her course. Alas, the queen refuses to be swayed and vanishes again, but not before revealing that she will erase the memories she has as a living person, that she might shed with conscience to become a devourer of worlds.
TEXT_KINGMF103_04948_SEQ_09: Wuk Lamat is dejected that she could not reason with Sphene. As you hear your friend's frustration, you find yourself wondering about the true nature of the Endless, and why Sphene goes to such lengths to protect them.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat's frustration is fairly palpable.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SEQ_01: With little else to be done at the Meso Terminal, Wuk Lamat suggests returning to the aetheryte. If Constancy is still there, he may be able to tell you more about Sphene's impending slumber and what that entails.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SEQ_02: As you search fruitlessly for Constancy, you are instead found by none other than Cahciua, who appears as she was as a living person. Having admitted that she had been an Endless all along, she offers to help with your mission to stop Sphene, but asks that you first consider a request of hers. To that end, she bids you join her at a place called Canal Town, which you can travel to from the nearby zip line station.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SEQ_03: You make the brief and exhilarating zip line trip to arrive at Canal Town, a charming and scenic zone built upon the water. There, Cahciua points out Endless going about their business, each and every one the very picture of happiness. These are the people Sphene strives to protect, and you cannot hide your shock when Cahciua reveals her request: to erase them all.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SEQ_04: Cahciua reasons that, if the Endless are gone, Sphene would have no motive to plunder aether from other worlds even should you fail to prevent interdimensonal fusion. Seeing the sense in her words, you agree to do as she asks while waiting for the Meso Terminal to become vulnerable. Before carrying out the deed, however, Wuk Lamat expresses her desire to meet the Endless, that she might better understand Sphene. Thus is it decided that you will speak with as many of the inhabitants of Living Memory as possible as you make your way to the terminals holding their memories.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SEQ_05: You speak with a number of Endless in Canal Town, learning what brings them joy. One of them, a self-professed gourmand, recommends the popcorn at the nearby stall, and you proceed there to satisfy your curiosity.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SEQ_06: You find that G'raha Tia has also been directed to the stall, and together you sample the snack. While you are shocked to discover that the food in Living Memory tastes like nothing to you, your reactions suffice to delight the gathered crowd. Afterwards, G'raha Tia mentions having seen a man who seemed to be frantically searching for something. Curious as to what the problem is, he asks you to accompany him to where he was seen.
TEXT_KINGMF104_04949_SEQ_07: The man no longer appears to be in the vicinity. If you can find him, however, perhaps you can be of assistance in some way.
TEXT_KINGMF105_04950_SEQ_00: G'raha Tia wishes to track down the troubled Endless.
TEXT_KINGMF106_04951_SEQ_00: Cahciua regards you and your companions with a sympathetic gaze.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat is eager to go after Otis.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_01: Having encountered an Endless incarnation of Ser Otis Velona in Yesterland, Wuk Lamat is eager to speak further with him. Thus do you set off towards the air cab station, where he appeared to have been bound.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_02: You find Otis rehearsing the lines for the upcoming Founding Celebration play, which tells the tale of the realm's birth. The knight reveals that, due to there being fewer Endless, it has become difficult to gather a crowd. To that end, he tasks you and Wuk Lamat with spreading word of the production to the younglings of Yesterland, for which he will provide child-pleasing animal costumes for the both of you to wear.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_03:
You don your costume and assume the guise of a friendly rabbit. As per Otis's instructions, you turn your attention to the children in the vicinity of the air cab station.

※You must be wearing the costume provided by Otis to complete this task. Speak with him again to prolong or restore the guise.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_04: You have told a good number of children about the play. Satisfied with your efforts, you make your way back to Otis.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_05: Having thanked you for promoting the production, Otis now asks you to perform a duel in it. Though Wuk Lamat is reluctant at first, your enthusiasm wins her over, and together you make your way to Proto Alexandria to prepare.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_06:
At last the play begins, and you perform your parts with aplomb. But when Otis takes the stage for his own, he is overcome by the memories of failing to protect his queen and freezes still. Fortunately, the day is saved when Wuk Lamat launches into an inspired improvisation which brings the tale to a satisfying conclusion.

Afterwards, when you finally manage to have a quiet moment with Otis, you reveal to him that you are in fact living people. Answering his questions, you tell him that Alexandria endures, and that his other self served the realm valiantly. Comforted by this knowledge, the knight declares that he may rest easy, his newfound peace comforting you in turn as you press on to the Geo Terminal.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_07: Wuk Lamat shuts down the terminal, causing the Endless in Yesterland to fade away. Her time here has impressed upon her how much Sphene's people loved her and yearned for peace, and she swears to carry it all with her.
TEXT_KINGMF107_04952_SEQ_08: Erasing the Endless is proving as difficult a deed as you had imagined. But so long as someone remembers them, they will never truly fade away...
TEXT_KINGMF108_04953_SEQ_00: Cahciua would guide you to the next zone.
TEXT_KINGMF109_04954_SEQ_01: As fate would have it, Krile has been reunited with her mother and father, Alayla and Robor. While uncertain how she should interact with her long-lost parents, with your support and encouragement, she sets off for the heatwells to make the most of this chance to be with them.
TEXT_KINGMF109_04954_SEQ_02: Krile and her parents' initial attempts to get acquainted prove awkward. As you observe their struggles, inspired by her experiences with xibruq pibil, Wuk Lamat offers to bring them food in a bid to break the ice. Alayla requests something cold, and you turn to your comrades to discuss options.
TEXT_KINGMF109_04954_SEQ_03: As this is a special moment, it is decided that you will look for a treat that will leave an impression. The search begins with asking locals for recommendations, and you make your way to leynode pyro to question the Endless there.
TEXT_KINGMF109_04954_SEQ_04: The answers you receive point you to a stall southwest of the leynode, which apparently offers something called gold star ice cream. Without delay, you set forth in search of it.
TEXT_KINGMF109_04954_SEQ_05: You arrive at the stall to find Wuk Lamat also eyeing it. The ice cream looks duly impressive if cumbersome, but confident in your transporting skills, you volunteer to deliver all three servings to Krile and her parents.
TEXT_KINGMF109_04954_SEQ_06: You have picked up the servings of gold star ice cream. Stepping quickly but lightly, you begin making your way back to Opal Springs.
TEXT_KINGMF109_04954_SEQ_07:
You deliver the ice cream intact, but even with the delightful treats, the awkward air persists between Krile and her parents. Thankfully, the ice is finally broken when G'raha Tia makes an artful intervention, and genuine smiles manifest upon the faces of all present.

At the meal's conclusion, Krile's parents tell you about interdimensional fusion. The key for invoking the power is a relic that belonged to their people, the Milalla, who employed it in the distant past to flee to another reality when a great calamity froze their homeland. When lightning then threatened this world, Robor and Alayla attempted to invoke the power once more, but were unable to do so. In desperation, they agreed to cooperate with Preservation only to discover that the order sought to siphon aether from other worlds. This led to the couple's defection, and in the course of fleeing pursuit, they brought their only daughter to the Source to keep her safe. So it is that Krile comes to know the truth of her origin, and in order to learn more about the Milalla, you decide to visit the cavern inside the volcano, where their ancient homeland has been recreated.
TEXT_KINGMF109_04954_SEQ_08: Standing at the entrance to the cavern, Krile expresses her heartfelt gratitude to you all. Thanks to your intervention, she was able to not only bond with her parents, but know the joy of sharing a meal with them besides.
TEXT_KINGMF110_04955_SEQ_00: Krile is eager to learn about the Milalla people.
TEXT_KINGMF111_04956_SEQ_00: Cahciua is ready to head to the fourth and final zone.
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_SEQ_00: Cahciua's eyes sparkle in anticipation of discovery.
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_SEQ_01: As part of her final adventure, Cahciua bids your party scout out Windspath Gardens for points of note. In particular, she is keen to compare the creatures here with those native to the Source, and you bear this in mind as you strike out for the task.
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_SEQ_02: You take yourself around the gardens and, through a combination of conversation and observation, make a number of interesting discoveries. Satisfied, you go to report them to Cahciua.
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_SEQ_03: After you delight Cahciua with your findings, Erenville mentions that he caught sight of an unfamiliar scalekin. His description of it, however, leads Cahciua to believe that it may instead be a beastkin, and it is decided that you will all seek it out for observation.
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_SEQ_04: You join mother and son for their discussion on wildlife classification, which leads to the revelation that not only did Cahciua meet Galuf during his time in Tural, but also that it was his tales of Sharlayan gleaners which led her to encourage Erenville to become one when he was older. Cahciua then expresses her desire to visit the Cleyra Museum of Nature, which she says has creatures that take patrons on leisure flights. As only three people can fly at a time, the group heading there is limited to Cahciua, Erenville, and yourself.
TEXT_KINGMF112_04957_SEQ_05: Arriving at the museum, you are greeted by the sight of three critters that, while adorable, look decidedly incapable of flight. As Cahciua states, however, one should not judge a creature by its appearance...
TEXT_KINGMF113_04958_SEQ_00: Cahciua is ready to take to the sky on mehwapyarra-back.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat's gaze is firmly fixed on the Meso Terminal.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SEQ_01: The moment of reckoning is at hand. Interdimensional fusion has been initiated, meaning the Meso Terminal is now vulnerable. Determined to carry out Cahciua's plan, you make haste back to the terminal at the heart of the city.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SEQ_02:
Unsurprisingly, one cannot simply shut down the Meso Terminal. In anticipation of this, Cahciua has left you with a program that will send your souls into its memory banks, where you are to seek out and stop Sphene. A virtual domain generated by her memories awaits, and dying there would mean dying in reality, but for the sake of the lives in all worlds, you must brave the dangers and see your mission through.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SEQ_03:
You fight your way through Sphene's lived memories, bearing witness to her past, to arrive at the innermost sector. All that remains is to confront your adversary and prevent her from harvesting life from other worlds.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with Erenville in Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SEQ_04:
At last you come face-to-face with Sphene, but not before her memories are expunged. Before your very eyes, the once-gentle queen is recreated as a terrifying entity, and she summarily expels your comrades before moving to erase you from existence. If you would protect all that you hold dear, your only choice now is to fight─and triumph.

※The Interphos can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SEQ_05: At the end of a grueling struggle, you succeed in defeating the monstrosity Sphene had become. To your surprise, she then reappears as she once was, having been remade from her memories as an Endless. Deeply remorseful, she apologizes for all the suffering she has caused, and entrusts her burdens to Wuk Lamat before going to join her beloved people in oblivion's embrace.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SEQ_06:
Together with your comrades, you make a triumphant return to Tuliyollal. Though much work remains to be done, the people again look to a brighter future.

You are resting in your cabin after the victory celebration when Wuk Lamat and Erenville pay you a visit. The Dawnservant thanks you for all that you have done for her nation, while the gleaner reveals that he has given up that calling, that he might fulfill his mother's dream of seeking discovery. And whatever your own plans may be, you are assured that you are a guest in Tuliyollal until you are ready to leave.
TEXT_KINGMF114_04959_SEQ_07: So it is that your grand adventure in Tural comes to an end. When first you set out in search of the legendary city of gold, little did you imagine that you would discover it to be a twisted utopia. And though Sphene is no more, her hopes survive in Wuk Lamat, who shall watch over her beloved subjects as they rebuild their lives. With the cycle of life restored to Alexandria, its people will once more live and die as creation had intended, with the legacy of one generation being passed down to the next. Thus carrying the memories of those you met in your heart, you look to the journeys still ahead. As you continue walking your path, you may collide with others and your steps may falter. But come what may, you find encouragement in the knowledge that the world shall ever be filled with wonders awaiting discovery.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SEQ_00: Bol Wuruq is eager to hear how you have been getting on.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SEQ_01: With Tuliyollal enjoying a period of relative peace, the attendant at the For'ard Cabins suggests you treat yourself to a plate of tacos at the nearby Xbalyav Ty'e. Br'uk Evu's cooking is said to be second to none, and his tavern likely has an open seat with your name on it.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SEQ_02: Br'uk Evu greets you with his characteristic hospitality and accepts your order. You find a table to sit at while your food is being prepared.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SEQ_03: As you get ready to enjoy your meal, you overhear a conversation between a father and his son, the latter who is struggling to adapt to life in the capital after thirty years in Alexandria. Just as the pair resolve to tackle this problem as a family, Wuk Lamat approaches to offer advice. Their situation is a common one, it seems, for she tells them about a group established to help impart the skills required for life outside the dome to returning Turali. Content with having helped her subjects, the Vow of Resolve leaves their table and finally notices you sitting nearby. After a bit of catching up, she mentions that she and Koana have something to discuss with you at the palace. Curious as to what the Dawnservants might want, you agree to attend them.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SEQ_04: You arrive at Sunperch, but the gatekeeper informs you that Koana is busy with pressing matters. He bids you wait inside until the Vow of Reason returns.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SEQ_05: Upon entering the throne room, you see several of the former Scions waiting as well. You briefly exchange news on your respective affairs before Koana enters the chamber and explains the reason for the summons: a funeral for Queen Sphene is to be held in Alexandria, and he asks if those present wish to attend. For personal and political reasons, Wuk Lamat decides to pay her respects as a representative of Tuliyollal and requests that you and your allies come along to keep watch over proceedings. With your course of action decided, you are to depart to Solution Nine, where Gulool Ja and Oblivion are making final preparations for the ceremony.
TEXT_KINGMG101_05244_SEQ_06: Gulool Ja is thankful that everyone could attend the funeral, which was planned with the aid of recently recovered historical records. These records indicate that flowers were once placed as offerings to deceased Alexandrians, and so flowers are being distributed to all the attendees. The young king likely knows where to receive them.
TEXT_KINGMG102_05245_SEQ_00: Gulool Ja wishes to go and collect his flower for the funeral.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SEQ_00: G'raha Tia has an idea on how you may proceed with your investigation.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SEQ_01: As neither memories nor records of Gulool Ja's mother may exist, G'raha Tia suggests splitting up to question the greatest number of people. He and the others will ask around Solution Nine, and you will gather information by speaking with the residents of the outskirts.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SEQ_02: While the people you question have no direct knowledge of the Mamool Ja you seek, their stories contain tidbits of Zoraal Ja's history that imply a larger picture with missing pieces. The best course of action would be to return to the Backroom and see if the others can help make the picture whole.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SEQ_03: The collected stories of you and your comrades reveal that nearly twenty years ago, Zoraal Ja began visiting a settlement located in a region known as Yuweyawata, where he once battled and defeated a tural vidraal, together with a cadre of Landsguard─one of whom was a female Mamool Ja. This settlement may have also been the site of clandestine research, and Shale determines its location by analyzing the history of supplies sent from Everkeep. With your next destination determined, Gulool Ja is eager to set forth and learn more of his family.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SEQ_04:
With a glimmer of excitement in his eyes, Gulool Ja says he is ready to cross the lake. The young king will stay close behind as you cut a path through the long-forgotten facility.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SEQ_05:
Besting both feral beasts and inhuman abominations, you traverse the derelict facility, slowly uncovering its terrible purpose. At the end of your path, you come upon a storm raging over a deep canyon, and as you draw near the winds cease as a howl resounds in your ears. Breaking free from its prison, a tural vidraal descends from the skies to wreak havoc upon the land. Yet even such boundless fury is no match for you and your allies, and after a fierce battle, the beast lies broken and dying.

※In the event that you leave Yuweyawata, you may return via the driftdowns.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SEQ_06: As you watch the tural vidraal breathe its final breath, the Echo imparts to you a vision of its past. In it, Zoraal Ja approves Kanilokka's proposal to experiment with the transference of human souls into bestial vessels, and after the researcher departs, Zoraal Ja is joined by a Mamool Ja woman. Addressing her as Teeshal Ja, the King of Resolve commands her to aid the project, and she accepts on one condition: that should the work bear fruit, she is permitted to take what she herself desires most of all. The vision ends on this vague note, and after you share its contents with the others, it is concluded that Teeshal Ja may be the woman you have been looking for. Emboldened by this new revelation, Gulool Ja wishes to search the facility further.
TEXT_KINGMG103_05246_SEQ_07: With the facility now devoid of threats, you are free to search for clues of Teeshal Ja's background. Gaining access to the upper floor of the observatory would be prudent at this juncture...
TEXT_KINGMG104_05247_SEQ_00: Krile is eager to begin searching the research facility.
TEXT_KINGMG105_05248_SEQ_00: Geode's concern is writ plain upon his face.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SEQ_00: Koana appears loath to part from his rroneek companion...
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SEQ_01: Having spent a fruitful stretch of time learning more of the rroneek and their care, you and Koana are rejoined by Wuk Lamat and Erenville, with whom Koana shares his recent revelations about these hhetso. In turn, they explain that they detected an unusual aetheric signature while investigating the rroneek's former grazing grounds─one that may be indicative of a predator. The Hhetsarro speculate that this may be a fearsome creature known as a “tturuhhetso,” or rroneek reaver. If so, it not only is the probable cause of the rroneek's change in grazing patterns, but also presents an imminent danger to the local herds.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SEQ_02: Further word of the reaver arrives more swiftly than anyone could have expected, as a Hhetsarro comes sprinting into the camp, shouting that the beast approaches. The rroneek's safety is the first priority of one and all, so you move to assist those currently roaming the plains. Ere long, however, the tturuhhetso itself appears. Koana throws himself between the predator and a threatened rroneek, and you and Wuk Lamat rush to his aid. Though stymied for a time by its adamantine scales, Koana soon finds a way to disrupt the flow of aether that strengthens them, and together, the three of you see the tturuhhetso slain.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SEQ_03: The defeat of the rroneek reaver brings two revelations. First, Koana realizes that by repurposing its scales, it might be possible to fashion a device to deter the rroneek from approaching any passing locomotives without restricting their freedom. Then, through the tale of a Hhetsarro trader, you learn that it was likely a tturuhhetso attack that saw Koana orphaned as an infant, and that he was not abandoned by his parents as he had believed for his entire life. With this new perspective, the Vow of Reason is at last able to find closure, as well as a newfound appreciation for his biological and adoptive families.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SEQ_04: Though it may never be conclusively proven, suspicion abounds that the rroneek reaver you encountered may have been the same specimen that preyed upon the people of Loazeniheta two decades past. In any case, slaying it appears to have brought Koana a measure of peace along with the solution to your locomotive conundrum, which ought to be shared with the railroad workers posthaste.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SEQ_05: Back at Shaaloani Station, you propose Koana's idea of an aetherial whistle to keep rroneek from the tracks. Wawlika and his crew immediately set to fashioning one for the locomotive, which is readied for a test run in the blink of an eye. As the whistle indeed proves effective, Nitowikwe declares the Xak Tural railroad officially back in business.
TEXT_KINGMG106_05249_SEQ_06: As Wawlika's crew sets to work ensuring the smooth operation of the new locomotive, you are free to turn your attention to other matters. Once more, Alexandria beckons.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SEQ_00: Never one to stand still, Wuk Lamat is ready to race back to Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SEQ_01: No sooner do you broach the subject of returning to the dome with Wuk Lamat than does Erenville inquire into the details of your business there. As it happens, he too is considering a sojourn to Alexandria, that he might find a way to aid those affected by the turmoil. Thus do you set off for the Backroom together─with his charming Cahciua curio in tow.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SEQ_02: You arrive at the perfect time to hear the fruits of Shale's labors: a series of audio diaries recorded by Teeshal Ja herself, detailing her feelings for Zoraal Ja and his rejection of their child. Though these disturbing revelations would be overwhelming even for an adult, Gulool Ja puts on a brave face, and even thanks present company for helping him to learn the truth of his birth at long last.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SEQ_03: With Gulool Ja's questions answered, Shale may now commit to other matters, such as Y'shtola's investigative foray into Living Memory. The pair depart with little fanfare, leaving you and your remaining companions to your own devices.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SEQ_04: As your primary concern outside of Gulool Ja is spreading word of the railroad's resumption of service, you speak with Geode, who in turn surprises you with the news that precious few people intend to make the journey to Tuliyollal. Given how many voiced their desire to do so before, this is an odd shift in sentiment indeed, and you and Wuk Lamat resolve to learn what prompted it.
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SEQ_05: As you approach a crowd gathered near the site of Sphene's funeral, it is clear from their discourse that they have not only failed to come to terms with their existential turmoil in your absence, but have worked themselves into an ever greater panic over their mortality. Glad are they, then, when their beloved Queen Sphene suddenly appears with a solution: to convert the people into Endless via neo regulators, that they need fear death no longer. Given that you were instrumental in the destruction of the Queen of Reason, you and Wuk Lamat immediately suspect deception, and your doubt only grows when “Sphene” mentions the caveat that, at present, her proposed boon will only be extended to five thousand citizens. Despite Wuk Lamat's protestations, none join you in your skepticism, for the Alexandrians seem to be afflicted with collective amnesia and have no recollection of her death or subsequent funeral...
TEXT_KINGMG107_05250_SEQ_06: As there is naught to be gained from continuing to make a spectacle of yourself in challenging the queen's claims, you rejoin your companions in the Backroom, there to await further intelligence from Oblivion's members in the field. You will need to proceed with caution until such time as you know more about the entity wearing Sphene's face.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_SEQ_00: Krile wishes to catch up on recent events.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_SEQ_01: In the Backroom, you are briefed on recent events by several Scion associates, as well as your Alexandrian and Tuliyollan allies. Wuk Lamat, for her part, has decided to stay in Alexandria until the mystery of the new Sphene has been unraveled, and on this subject, you learn that the Queen of Reason has often been sighted around the city, urging her citizens to become Endless. Curiously, those who still wear regulators appear to have no memory of her death. However, while these developments are cause for concern, it appears there is a more pressing matter. A guest has been brought to the Backroom, and Krile bids you visit the break room, where Y'shtola and Alisaie even now attend to them.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_SEQ_02:
The break room can be accessed through a door located in the corner of the Backroom. You need but cross the threshold to meet the mysterious guest who awaits.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return from the Backroom in Solution Nine.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_SEQ_03: You follow the hallway to a small sleeping area, and upon one of the beds you see a woman who looks strikingly familiar. Y'shtola reveals that she is the original, still-living Queen Sphene, whom she and Shale found wandering Living Memory during their investigation of the area. Upon bringing her to Solution Nine, they decided to treat the aetheric imbalance in her body with a porxie. As you digest this turn of events, Sphene opens her eyes, reacting with confusion before slowly regaining her senses. Y'shtola informs the former queen of her centuries-long slumber, yet this is but the first of many revelations she must receive.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_SEQ_04: Joined by G'raha Tia and Krile, you and the others discuss with Sphene the four hundred years that have passed since she was placed in deep sleep. The conversation is long, but afterwards Sphene is grateful for everyone's patience. Even so, it is plain she still wrestles with the newfound knowledge of her situation and the home she has lost. Sensing her discomfort, Gulool Ja suggests going out into the city, so Sphene can see what modern Alexandria is like, and Wuk Lamat heartily agrees.
TEXT_KINGMH101_05299_SEQ_05: Sphene seems excited by the prospect of exploration and the opportunity to become acquainted with you and your allies. In the meantime, you prepare to serve as escort to Alexandria's new guest.
TEXT_KINGMH102_05300_SEQ_00: Sphene is eager to see the new Alexandria.
TEXT_KINGMH104_05302_SEQ_00: Sphene is eager to tell Malachite of your success.
TEXT_KINGMH105_05303_SEQ_00: Sphene has a pained look in her eyes.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SEQ_00: Shale is eager to get on with it.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SEQ_01: Shale informs you that she has secured passage to the foundation sector, and that she will accompany you to gather data on the uncharted area. You and your companions head to the government sector, where the lift to Everkeep's depths is located.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SEQ_02:
Your party assembles at the lift, and before you board Shale hands you a communicator. The adapter will use the coordinate data it provides to guide you as you delve into Everkeep's depths, where the old castle is said to be preserved.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SEQ_03:
After disembarking the lift and pushing through a sandy area crawling with beasts, the former castle of Alexandria comes into sight. You and your allies approach its timeworn doors, only to be assaulted by mechanized guardians, and during the melee you hear the voice of Calyx beckoning you deeper into the castle, where he intends to further test your combat capabilities. Cutting through more foes, you reach a chamber occupied by an ancient but hostile machine, and after a fierce battle you stand victorious. Shale and Sphene catch up, and together you prepare to search the fortress in earnest.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by talking to the lift attendant in the government sector.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SEQ_04:
During your exploration of the castle, Sphene reminisces about her time spent there in centuries past─a heartfelt moment interrupted when you both are suddenly transported to a decrepit room. The moldering surroundings are soon replaced by virtual overlays recreating the throne of Alexandria in its former glory. At the center of the chamber are Calyx and the simulant, the former stating that he has one last trial with which to test your mettle, before a hulking mass of metal descends onto the arena. The simulant addresses it as Zelenia, who was second-in-command of Alexandria's royal knights. Overcome with rage at this affront, Sphene begs your aid in destroying the ignoble machine, even though it means you will be playing right into Calyx's hands.

※Recollection can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SEQ_05:
The imitation of Alexandria's finest proves to be a formidable opponent, but yet again you manage to pull through. Calyx seems unperturbed by the destruction of his creation, and appraises you with a look that suggests he possesses knowledge you do not.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the lift attendant in the government sector.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SEQ_06: Calyx reveals that he covets the key that he might use it to harvest aether from reflections to sustain a growing population of Endless, and in so doing facilitate the evolution of mankind. He then states he will bestow upon you a “gift” before ending the transmission and stripping the room of its illusory grandeur, leaving you and Sphene standing before a dilapidated throne, upon which a tiara rests.
TEXT_KINGMH106_05304_SEQ_07: Although Sphene is torn by the reminder of Zelenia's loss, she is grateful for you striking down the creation that disgraced her memory. As you look around the chamber, it remains unclear just how far into the castle's depths you have been thrust...
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SEQ_01: Your meeting with Milos seems to have lifted Sphene's spirits, and she proposes buying a gift for your friends in the Backroom. However, your shopping is interrupted when an unfamiliar voice uses Alexandria's loudspeakers to inform one and all that neo regulators will no longer be distributed to the populace. The news sparks unease among those nearby, and you decide to make haste and return to the Backroom immediately. Shale greets you with a mixture of concern and relief, but shortly thereafter you are informed by Nostalgia that one of Alexandria's citizens was killed by a rogue mechanical soldier. Before your comrades can process this news, Erenville contacts you via linkpearl, reporting a similar incident in the outskirts. He then breaks contact after saying he will try to lead a group of soldiers away from a nearby settlement. Shale entreats you to go to his aid, and you quickly assemble a group to investigate Erenville's last known location.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SEQ_02: When you arrive at the settlement in the outskirts, Erenville is nowhere in sight. Wuk Lamat instructs Sphene and Gulool Ja to search the settlement while you, she, and Alisaie search further outside for your missing ally.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SEQ_03: You scour East Yyasulani until you finally catch sight of a group of mechanical soldiers assaulting a pair of Shetona. The faulty sentries fall quickly before your wrath, and luckily the two frightened men appear to be unharmed.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SEQ_04: Not soon after you help Erenville and the other Shetona to their feet, Alisaie and Wuk Lamat join you. As you share your experiences and observations, it becomes clear that there is no rhyme or reason to which soldiers are hostile, and which are friendly. Erenville wishes to check on the other civilians, and together you return to the settlement.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SEQ_05:
Your allies are gathered near the aetheryte along with a familiar face: Malachite. He tells you he came to the settlement to retrieve the slain citizen, but when he arrived, the body was nowhere to be found. The usher returns to Solution Nine, and not soon after, you and others present are contacted by others via linkpearl. From G'raha Tia in the city, you learn of an incident caused by malfunctioning machinery─one of many similar instances of Alexandrians being hurt by machines and soldiers, it would seem. Upon hearing of the developing situation, Sphene rushes towards Solution Nine, and Wuk Lamat follows close on her heels. Leaving Erenville in the care of the other Oblivion members, you and your companions head toward the city, uncertain what awaits.

The familiar sounds of combat fill the air as you enter Solution Nine and spy scattered fires in the distance. You come upon Wuk Lamat caring for a wounded citizen, and she bids you go ahead and catch up with Sphene. Fighting your way through rogue soldiers and malfunctioning machines, you find the former queen kneeling before the lifeless body of an Alexandrian. While Sphene is overcome with emotion by this senseless slaughter, she is determined to fight on, and together you go to reunite with your allies in the government sector. There you learn that the machines seem to have ceased their rampage, and none of your companions were injured in the chaos. Alas, the same cannot be said for Alexandria's people, and Sphene asks that you help render aid. You and your allies pledge to do so, and all present make ready to commence rescue and relief efforts, while G'raha Tia bids you return to the Backroom and inform Shale of all that has transpired.
TEXT_KINGMH108_05306_SEQ_06: While the tidings you bring Shale are far from good, she is quick to form a plan to have Oblivion's people keep watch over Alexandria's machines. Amidst this uneasy peace, you and your allies must hone your skills and search for Calyx, whose whereabouts and future schemes remain a mystery.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SEQ_00: Shale wishes for a moment of your time.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SEQ_01: The machine rampages have caused much strife and heartache, and while there have since been no new incidents to report, Gulool Ja warns that his renewed control over the now-disarmed soldiers may be temporary at best. Calyx, the mastermind behind the attacks, seems capable of commandeering Alexandria's machines at will. Sphene recalls what she can of the genius engineer from her age, and attempts to make sense of his declared motivations for “improving” mankind. While Preservation did indeed contribute to Alexandria's growth and development in centuries past, Calyx's fixation on creating Endless has led to untold suffering. He must be stopped─but if you would foil his schemes, Shale laments that you will first need to find him. To that end, Geode suggests a patrol to survey the streets and search for information which may help lead you to your elusive enemy.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SEQ_02: You reconvene on the street outside the Neon Stein, where Geode considers the uneasy faces of his countrymen. Bolstered by Sphene's faith in Alexandrians to decide a course for the future, he turns his full attention to the task at hand. While Krile and Sphene will patrol the west of the recreation zone, you and Geode look to question citizens in the east.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SEQ_03:
Geode is ready to begin your patrol and speak with the people you meet along the way. He suggests paying special attention to those appearing overwhelmed or overly excited, in the hopes that they might yield more useful details about the current situation.

※You must be accompanied by Geode to complete this task. Speak with him again should you become separated.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SEQ_04: You make your way through the recreation zone and speak with several residents about the recent attacks. Geode then muses that there was one factor in their stories you all neglected to consider previously: that the victims may not have been wearing regulators. With this suspicion in mind, you take to the streets to speak with the locals once more.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SEQ_05: Your specific line of questioning leads to the confirmation that people without regulators were almost certainly being targeted. Armed with this new information, you look to rejoin Krile and Sphene at the agreed rendezvous point.
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SEQ_06:
After sharing your findings with the others, you recall another familiar detail in the story you heard from Malachite. Bodies had gone missing from several sites where citizens died in both the outskirts and recreation zones, and in their place were found strange piles of dust. As you make plans to investigate further, a panicked Gulool Ja contacts you with a plea for help, fearing that the residential radii have come under attack.

You hasten to the apartment buildings and find hostile mechanical soldiers assaulting the residents. No sooner have you saved one citizen than you hear a commotion coming from Isadora and Milos's quarters. Upon entering, you find the aftermath of Wayakkwe's battle with a murderous drone, but the wounded Oblivion member urges you to tend to Isadora first. Sphene puts her retrained magicks to work, healing the critically injured mother and comforting the distraught Milos. The worst appears to have passed, but Wayakkwe remains visibly shaken...
TEXT_KINGMI101_05364_SEQ_07: Her own wounds now mended, Wayakkwe asks after her Oblivion comrade. Recalling the scene from the lobby, a distraught Sphene shares his unfortunate fate...
TEXT_KINGMI102_05365_SEQ_00: Wayakkwe is fearful for her comrade.
TEXT_KINGMI103_05366_SEQ_00: Though gripped by sadness, Sphene spurs herself to action.
TEXT_KINGMI104_05367_SEQ_00: Shale steels her heart for the work ahead.
TEXT_KINGMI105_05368_SEQ_00: Wuk Lamat assesses her surroundings with grim determination.
TEXT_KINGMI106_05369_SEQ_00: Shale is examining the card scanner.
TEXT_KINGMI107_05370_SEQ_00: Sphene is resolved to take part in the coming battle.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_00: Y'shtola would proceed to the Meso Terminal.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_01: Following a brief reunion with your companions by the aetheryte in Living Memory, Y'shtola deems the party assembled and ready to proceed. The darkened Meso Terminal looms in the distance, awaiting your approach.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_02:
Upon arriving at the foot of the terminal, Sphene relives her recent awakening. She gives thanks to those who have preserved the spirit of her beloved Alexandria, past and present, and together you reaffirm your commitment to fighting against Calyx's callous designs. The opening in the structure's wall glitters with golden energy, inviting you to venture within and confront the architect of Alexandria's mounting mortal dilemma...

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_03:
You have defeated the Endless entities Calyx has sent against you and secured a path to the Meso Terminal's upper reaches. Now you must ascend to the structure's pinnacle, there to bring an end to this calculated confrontation.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return via the entrance at the foot of the Meso Terminal.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_04:
Calyx commends you on your perseverance in reaching him. As you persist in refusing to yield the key, however, he proceeds to summon an entity designed for the sole purpose of defeating you. The chamber darkens with an innervating chill, and the fear of inevitable death flowing from Alexandria's enthralled citizens feeds the manifestation of a terrifying primal being. Though the device holding Calyx's memories is tantalizingly close, you must first contend with this horror whose grasp promises naught but eternal darkness.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return via the entrance at the foot of the Meso Terminal.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_05: Fighting as one, you triumph over the summoned primal, and you feel the pall of fear lift from your beleaguered hearts. It is time to bring an end to Calyx's Endless ambitions, and return with your companions to the promenades of Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_06: You strike against the memory bank, only to discover it is shielded by a powerful barrier. As Calyx mocks your efforts, the air grows heavy, the weight of mortal dread once more pressing down upon you. In a dry, academic tone, Calyx explains that the experience of death has only strengthened his creation─that it will rise, again and again, until the lightning aether suffusing his ravaged world is drained to its last spark. However, his promise of enduring memories prompts Sphene to recall the true meaning of those words and the comfort they were meant to offer. With Shale's help, she broadcasts a message of hope across Alexandria, buoying the citizens and interrupting the flow of prayer to the primal. Taking advantage of its momentary weakness, your party divides its efforts, with one half battling the entity, and the other working to bring down the barrier protecting the device. Wuk Lamat and Sphene's combined attack finally shatters the energy shield, while Alisaie delivers the killing blow to your enfeebled enemy. Calyx can only monitor the progress of his memory transfer in silent desperation as you spring into action, your decisive strike causing the memory bank to erupt in a spectacular explosion. In the wake of this destruction, Calyx has winked out of existence, and an exhausted Wuk Lamat collapses to the ground, her promise fulfilled.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_07: You exit the terminal with the unconscious Wuk Lamat, and Alphinaud concludes that his patient will survive to see another morrow─though she will be spending that day and many others resting abed. With Preservation no longer a threat, he offers to remain behind until Vow Koana comes to retrieve her. Meanwhile, you and your comrades must return to the outskirts, and begin the task of putting Alexandria and its people back to rights.
TEXT_KINGMI108_05371_SEQ_08: In the aftermath of the primal summoning, it becomes clear that all who adopted the neo regulators have fallen under the entity's sway. Alexandria's government and citizens have come together to bring the afflicted into custody, but it may help ease Sphene's mind to see the state of the people firsthand.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SEQ_00: Sphene wishes to check on the state of the outskirts.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SEQ_01: Sphene is eager to follow the suggestion that she check in on her countrymen, but fears that speaking with those who are unaware of her return would prove more disruptive than not. Thankfully, Krile's advice to visit Mahuwsa at Yyupye's Halo seems the perfect compromise, as the fieldworker is aware of Sphene's circumstances and would surely be glad to know you all are alive and well.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SEQ_02: You are welcomed by Mahuwsa, who gives a brief account of the chaos which arose from the enthrallment of those wearing neo regulators. She is optimistic for the future, however, thanking you for putting a stop to Calyx and praising Sphene for her uplifting speech. After Mahuwsa leaves to aid the residents of the outskirts, the discussion turns to the subject of recruiting arcane practitioners to assist with the treatments. While your comrades are occupied with this endeavor, Alisaie asks if you might track down Gulool Ja, who is currently making every problem in the kingdom his personal responsibility to solve. Taapu in the driftdowns should be able to point you in his and Erenville's direction.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SEQ_03: As promised, Taapu is able to direct you to where Gulool Ja is hopefully taking a well-earned rest. She suggests you look for him somewhere in the vicinity of the old Alexandrian ruins.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SEQ_04: Delighted to see you, Gulool Ja explains that he has heard from Koana regarding Wuk Lamat's condition, but relief wars with frustration as he laments how his lack of strength has hindered his ability to help others. He then takes you to a spot where he keeps both his father's and Otis's swords, and shares his plans to train with the Landsguard that he might one day be worthy to wield these blades. Erenville offers his warm encouragement, and Gulool Ja, his path decided, wrests a promise from you to spar with him when he has grown bigger.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SEQ_05: Gulool Ja thanks you for listening to his future ambitions and assures you that he will take things one step at a time. Asserting that all is well with them for the moment, Erenville urges you to stop by the Backroom to pay Shale a visit.
TEXT_KINGMI109_05372_SEQ_06: You arrive in the Backroom to meet a visibly relieved Shale. She expresses her heartfelt gratitude for your deeds, and the mood shifts to one of celebration.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SEQ_00: Shale is visibly relieved at your safe return.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SEQ_01: You pause a moment to let Shale savor the recent victory. For her, it represents the culmination of years of rebellion, and marks the end of an era for Oblivion itself. Triumphs aside, Krile wonders if you have seen the last of the troubles arising from the key. The Scion leaves you with that unsettling thought as she heads off to her meeting with G'raha Tia and the city officials. Shale, too, returns to her own waiting tasks, but not before inviting you to rest in the Backroom while you watch over Alexandria's return to normalcy.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SEQ_02:
You while away the days in the Backroom, coming and going as you please. In the weeks that pass, Oblivion uncovers several Preservation facilities and makes a comprehensive study of regulator function. This leads to the understanding that memories of the deceased were never truly erased, merely locked away, and that this process can be reversed by sending a signal from the Meso Terminal.

Acting at the government's behest, your party and Sphene escort Gossan to Living Memory, where a much-recovered Wuk Lamat makes a surprise appearance. Together, you reactivate the terminals, and restore the memories of those who consented. The reaction in Alexandria is immediate and bittersweet, with many bursting into tears at the sudden flood of long-lost remembrances.

Gossan is grateful for your actions, and responds to Sphene's request to remain in Alexandria with an unexpected demand of his own: it seems that, inspired by the gentle leadership she displayed when despair held the kingdom in thrall, the people have insisted that she take her rightful place as their monarch. After much flustered deliberation, Sphene accepts the role, declaring peace and prosperity for Alexandria as her foremost purpose. Thus do you stand witness to the rise of a new Queen of Reason.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SEQ_03: A determined Sphene returns to meet her citizens with her chief aide at her side, the Scions joining them to assist with any confusion stemming from memory restoration. Erenville and Wuk Lamat also prepare to depart, the Vow of Resolve urging you to come and visit her at the palace so that she and Koana might thank you properly for your deeds.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SEQ_04: You approach the two Vows outside Vollok Shoonsa only to find Gulool Ja there as well, having come to begin his training under the Landsguard. After showing enthusiastic support for her nephew's ambition to learn swordplay, Wuk Lamat turns her attention to you. She expresses joy at how events unfolded for the queens past and present, and thanks you for helping her fulfill her promise. Erenville, meanwhile, speaks of an impending extended journey, and Koana declares his intent to compile a thorough account of Tuliyollan history even as he attends to his day-to-day administrative duties. With plans shared and assurances to reunite exchanged, they send you on your way back to Sphene and the other Scions.
TEXT_KINGMI110_05373_SEQ_05: Your arrival in Alexandria is met with discussion of the daunting tasks which lie ahead of Sphene, now that her kingdom will engage more openly with the other nations of Etheirys. Her citizens, too, have elected to face their grief with courage─the precious memories they have reclaimed serving to guide and sustain them through the days to come. Whether you are staying to investigate Preservation's mysteries, or departing to seek distant adventures, the soon-to-be-crowned Queen of Reason offers you all, her cherished comrades, the eternal hospitality of the nation you so valiantly saved.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SEQ_00: Alphinaud has something he wishes to tell you.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SEQ_01: With Calyx defeated and his schemes undone, it is time for you and your companions to consider the future. Though the matter of investigating the Ascians' interference in historical events of the Ninth remains, Y'shtola volunteers to continue working with Shale to lay bare any lingering secrets, leaving Alphinaud and Alisaie free to return to their efforts to aid the people of Garlemald. Via a sudden linkpearl call, you learn that Erenville, too, will soon be departing for lands afar, so you hasten to the Backroom to collect Shale, who surely wishes to say her own farewells.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SEQ_02: You find Shale precisely where you expected: at her station in the Backroom. To your companions' surprise, she is tempted away from her work with little fuss. Apparently, the documents recovered from the containment complex still require time to decrypt, and so she is free to attend to personal matters─such as seeing off a taciturn Viera.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SEQ_03: You arrive at High Tide Harbor to find Erenville resigned to his fate, though he nevertheless makes a token protest at being subject to fond farewells. Now, all that remains is to wait for Alphinaud and Alisaie to join you.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SEQ_04: Those remaining in Tural offer heartfelt good-byes and promises of future reunions to those departing. As you see them off, the ship carrying Erenville, Alphinaud, and Alisaie gradually shrinks to a tiny dot on the horizon, before vanishing entirely.
TEXT_KINGMJ101_05426_SEQ_05: What comes next, along with your role in it, remains unclear. By the sounds of it, however, Krile has an idea...
TEXT_KINGMJ102_05427_SEQ_00: Krile has a proposal to make.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SEQ_00: Despite the ominous landscape and persistent echoes of thunder, Krile is determined to press on.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SEQ_01:
A cursory look around the levin-blasted landscape confirms that if civilization has survived on the Ninth, it is not to be found near the crater that once was Alexandria. Sphene suggests nearby Treno, a port city-state and hub of trade on the continent, as a likely location of survivors. However, due to the violent lightning storm that spans as far as the eye can see, the airship cannot make the journey. Though Clerk PX-0093 remains on standby should you need to fly back to Living Memory, henceforth, you must walk.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with Clerk PX-0061 at leynode mnemo.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SEQ_02:
Sphene leads you to a nearby cave system that should provide passage through the mountains to Treno. From what you can see from the entrance, it does not appear to have suffered structural damage in the intervening time, so you and your companions prepare to sally forth into the darkness.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SEQ_03:
Though the path was winding and arduous, you have found your way through the gates of Treno, and put down many a threat to the local populace besides. The glow of the city's lamps welcomes you to what apparently remains a thriving bastion of civilization.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return from the Alexandria crater below Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SEQ_04: In the heart of Treno, you are greeted with cheerful thanks echoing through the local speaker system, followed by an equally cheerful greeting from the mayor, Miayli. The elder Milalla is concerned by the fate of Alexandria, and so Sphene and Y'shtola volunteer to tell her of all that has come to pass while the rest of your party explores the city. Miayli suggests you begin by speaking to her grandson, Lumull, who can put you to work aiding the townsfolk.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SEQ_05: You find Lumull passing out some manner of herbal remedy called “Sleepless Rhapsody,” which he insists that you try. He is also strangely keen to see your face when you do...
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SEQ_06: After marshaling your courage and quaffing the face-puckering drink, you share a polite version of your impressions, as Krile and G'raha recall their past experiences facing similar trials. In short order, however, you learn that the remedy's benefits are worth tolerating the taste. Not only do you feel surprisingly refreshed, but Lumull also explains that Sleepless Rhapsody mitigates the deleterious effects of exposure to lightning aether, further noting that the recipe has been passed down by the Milalla for generations.
TEXT_KINGMJ103_05428_SEQ_07: Now that he has had the opportunity to enjoy your reaction to Sleepless Rhapsody, Lumull finally remembers to introduce himself. Perhaps one day he will get around to giving you your work orders...
TEXT_KINGMJ104_05429_SEQ_00: Lumull is not yet ready to release you to the sweet meditations of manual labor.
TEXT_KINGMJ105_05430_SEQ_00: Lumull is vibrating with nervous energy.
TEXT_KINGMJ107_05432_SEQ_00: Krile is speculating as to the cause of your allies' delayed return.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_00: Lumull is resolved to meet the Doomtrain head-on─but would prefer to depart before he can think about it any longer.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_01: Preparations made, you speak with Lumull, who encourages you to climb aboard the hover cargo. The sooner, the better, for the Doomtrain draws nearer with every passing moment...
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_02:
After a few words of warning, you are seated by the cargo operator and lift off, bound for Bentini.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the cargo operator in Overture Plaza.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_03:
You arrive at the depot, where Lumull shares the details of his plan. Whilst he drives the locomotive, you are to ride a flatcar at the rear of the train so as to remain in range of your screaming steel foe. Though you have triumphed over your fair share of formidable enemies, it remains to be seen if prior experience has sufficiently prepared you for the coming battle with doom incarnate.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the cargo operator in Overture Plaza.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_04:
Following a mere few brushes with death─and the sacrifice of several flatcars─you manage to put the brakes on the runaway Doomtrain once and for all. With luck, the rest of the ride back to Treno will afford some opportunity to catch your breath, for there is no telling what awaits within the city.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return by speaking with the cargo operator in Overture Plaza, or via the Alexandria crater below Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_05: Lumull slows your own train to a stop, and the two of you make immediately for the center of town. Per Eyaney's detector, several beasts stalk the streets, and these must be dealt with before you might consider the crisis resolved.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_06:
Alongside your companions, you defeat the last of the marauding creatures─including a hulking, hypercharged behemoth. Krile in particular makes a remarkable show of determination and ingenuity, driving herself to her very limits to protect the people of Treno.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return from the Alexandria crater below Living Memory.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_07: With the Doomtrain's entourage destroyed, and the barrier restored, those inside the city can now rest easy. When you return to Main Street, you are received as heroes. Miayli, for her part, is delighted to see your group largely unharmed─though it is Krile who seems to draw her focus. Gently, she asks the younger Milalla whether she knows the name “Alayla,” prompting Krile to collapse to the flagstones in a combination of shock and exhaustion. Seeing this, Miayli promises to tell the tale of both Alayla and the key, though only after Treno's saviors have had sufficient rest. Fortunately, Y'shtola is quick to draw upon her healing magicks, that her friend might have her answers ere long.
TEXT_KINGMJ108_05433_SEQ_08: You speak with Krile, who has found her feet again thanks to Y'shtola's ministrations. Betraying a touch of hesitation as to what comes next, she asks whether you might not wish to undergo similar treatment before Miayli shares her story...
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SEQ_00: Krile is ready to hear more from Miayli─or is she?
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SEQ_01: You speak with Krile, who is in the process of steeling herself to receive the answers she has for so long sought. Her resolve hardened, she tells your group that the time to speak with Miayli is come.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SEQ_02:
Joined by Lumull and Eyaney, Miayli reveals that her entire family line is descended from the Milalla Speakers of eld─a line that includes Krile, whose mother Alayla was none other than Miayli's beloved sister. It was Alayla's role as Speaker that motivated her both to unlock the key's mysteries and to keep it from falling into the wrong hands, and as her successor, Miayli now feels it her duty to ensure that the relic is safe with you. Thankfully, she is satisfied with your conduct and more than willing to give her blessing that you keep it in your possession. Since Alayla took the historical documents pertaining to the key with her when she joined Preservation, the mayor can provide no further information concerning it─but she can provide Krile with assurances that neither her parents nor her living family would bear her ill will for calling the Source home.

As your comrades make for Overture Plaza, where Miayli has promised you fanfare to accompany your departure, she calls you back for one final word of warning. It is her belief that the key is guided to the hands of its bearers by a mysterious force not unlike fate itself...and if that force has taken an interest in you, you should expect danger to follow.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SEQ_03: Miayli and her people see you off with an abundance of warmth, while Krile vows to return to visit her relatives and treat the levin-afflicted. All too soon, you are back on the road to Alexandria, but the grateful smiles of Treno's people are sure to remain with you a long time yet.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SEQ_04: Back in Living Memory, and with greater certainty than ever that the key's secrets are to be found within Preservation's trove, your comrades make plans to check in with Shale once more. First, however, you must escort Sphene back so she may resume her queenly duties.
TEXT_KINGMJ109_05434_SEQ_05: Though Gossan has a few stern words for Sphene regarding her unannounced absence, she manages to smooth it over with talk of reestablishing relations with Treno. Stressing that you should not hesitate to seek her out should the need arise, she and her aide depart─to be replaced moments later by Shale who, as it transpires, was on her way to the containment complex to review the partially decrypted data in its full context. Y'shtola immediately volunteers to join her, and they head off, promising to inform you the very moment they have conclusions to share. Krile, too, will be occupied for a time with her porxie project, so you find yourself free until you are inevitably called upon once more.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_SEQ_00: Krile has a wistful glint in her eyes.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_SEQ_01:
Having returned from the Mist Continent, Krile reflects upon her time in Treno and reaffirms her commitment to support Miayli and the rest of the Milalla community that abide there. As thoughts turn from the storm-scarred environs of the Ninth to the revelations that might await in Preservation's research documents, Y'shtola informs you via linkpearl that their decryption efforts have met with success. Wishing to share their findings, she bids you join her and Shale in the deuterolab located within the containment complex.

※Speak with the lift attendant in Resolution to travel to Containment Complex 10-29.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_SEQ_02: According to Shale and Y'shtola, the decrypted data shed no light on how Calyx came to learn primal summoning techniques. However, the documents did reveal much about Preservation's experiments with the key, not to mention their attempts to control its world-bridging capabilities by means of an actuation device. The decision is made to remove the contraption, using the conveniently functional mechanism designed for that express purpose. As the key is liberated from its vessel, Krile receives a linkpearl call from a concerned Ojika Tsunjika, who relays that Tataru wishes to speak with the group, though she is loath to impose by requesting your immediate return. You nevertheless resolve to depart for Sharlayan, where Tataru is currently staying, and bid a heartfelt farewell to Shale, leaving Y'shtola to further examine the key.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_SEQ_03: Ojika greets you in the Baldesion Annex, reiterating his concern for Tataru before offering to go and fetch her. Sensing you might be tired from your journey, he invites you to relax in the main hall while he is gone.
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_SEQ_04: Though Tataru is delighted to see you, the jubilant mood does not last long. She reveals that rumors of voidsent emerging from fissures across the star have reached her ears─rumors since verified by the Grand Company of Eorzea itself. When Krile voices her fears concerning Garlemald and its deep connection to the void, Tataru mentions a report from Alphinaud and Alisaie, who were present when the trouble there unfolded...
TEXT_KINGMK101_05470_SEQ_05: It seems that not long after the twins had shared their Turali adventures with the Garlean community, terrified imperial soldiers brought word of voidsent attacks on Lapis Manalis and a munitions factory known as the Clyteum. Having brought everyone up to speed, Tataru urges you to make for Garlemald immediately, where Alphinaud and Alisaie are preparing to support Jullus and his forces. Thus does your brief sojourn in Sharlayan come to an end.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_SEQ_00: G'raha Tia wears a pensive expression.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_SEQ_01: With time of the essence, G'raha Tia and Krile promptly leave for Garlemald. You prepare to follow them to Tertium, where Alphinaud and the others will be waiting.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_SEQ_02:
Upon your arrival, Alphinaud outlines the current situation. While the Ilsabard contingent is close to prevailing in Lapis Manalis, the Garleans are greatly outnumbered and in need of urgent assistance. You steel yourself for the fierce fighting ahead, sights fixed upon the Clyteum─and the yawning fissure that awaits within.

※To enlist your companion NPCs for this duty, speak with them near the entrance or access Duty Support via the main menu. Use the Duty Finder if you wish to complete the instance alongside fellow players.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_SEQ_03: Deep within the cavernous munitions factory, you encounter Malphas─a powerful voidsent adept at manipulating matter with strands of aetheric energy. The twisted creature assembles rusted magitek contraptions into vicious automata, sending them against you with glee. Nevertheless, the collective might of these mindless minions proves no match for you and your companions.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_SEQ_04: The battle won, Jullus rejoins you, breathing a sigh of relief that the ordeal is over. As Urianger moves to seal the fissure through which Malphas entered, the creature cries out in desperation, begging to return to the void. Intrigued, Jullus asks your permission to treat with the voidsent, ultimately learning that they long to see the Thirteenth how it once was, unsullied by Darkness. The young Garlean thus bids Malphas to seek out Zero and lend their hand in restoring the void. The group watches as this defeated foe and potential ally retreats into the fissure, and afterwards resolves to rendezvous in Tertium.
TEXT_KINGMK102_05471_SEQ_05: Back in Tertium, Jullus shares reports that the Ilsabard contingent has successfully contained the threat in Lapis Manalis. With the Clyteum likewise purged of voidsent, Garlemald should be safe for the time being.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_00: Something weighs heavy on Thancred's mind.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_01:
As you and your comrades discuss the propensity for fissures to manifest in regions where the barrier between the Source and the void is at its thinnest, Urianger is struck by a dire realization: it is not Garlemald, but the moon with its great voidgate that is most vulnerable to voidsent incursion. Fearing the worst, the group makes ready to depart for Bestways Burrow. Before you leave, Jullus sheepishly hands you a parcel laden with dumplings, asking it be delivered to Zero on the off chance you encounter her. Whether your journey to the moon will lead thence to the Thirteenth remains unclear, but you gladly accept the delicious cargo.

Upon your arrival in Bestways Burrow, Mappingway reveals that the moon is indeed inundated with voidsent, adding that Livingway hasn't been seen since venturing out to activate the brands. You resolve to seek out Livingway─though it is all but certain she is not the only Loporrit in need of rescue...
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_02: You soon encounter a diminutive figure beset by fiends. After making short work of the vile assailants, you pause to ascertain the poor Loporrit's well-being.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_03: The shaken Loporrit reveals they saw Livingway marching towards the Drowning Brand accompanied by a gaggle of slaughter-bots. You duly set off in search of her.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_04: As you reach the Drowning Brand, you spot Livingway surrounded by voidsent, the remains of her slaughter-bot retinue scattered across the ground nearby. Dealing swiftly with the fiends, you move to make sure the Loporrit is unharmed.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_05: Though Livingway is rattled by her ordeal, she appears none the worse for wear. Thanking you profusely for your aid, she informs you that the brands have been activated and further voidsent ingress is unlikely. As if on cue, an almighty roar issues from the crater, casting doubt on that assertion...
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_06:
As Livingway laments your inevitable doom, G'raha Tia and Y'shtola rush over. After you brief them on events thus far, Y'shtola's thoughts turn to Zero and Golbez, whose domain lies beyond the voidgate. At the mention of your comrades, vivid memories of your time in the Thirteenth come flooding back, and Azem's crystal begins to glow, resonating with the key in Y'shtola's possession. Floating out of Y'shtola's grasp, it begins to shine ever brighter until a dazzling white light fills your vision, and a mysterious voice echoes in your ears. Naming the key “Ethos,” the voice bids you go forth and unite the stars. With the blinding light now replaced by limitless dark, you have little time to contemplate these words before the key projects a path of golden light unto a radiant portal, from beyond which Golbez and Zero can be heard─evidently in the midst of battle. Without hesitation, you dash forward into the portal, ready to come to their aid.

You emerge onto the void's red moon where your comrades are engaged with a veritable horde of fiends. During a lull in the fighting, a startled Zero notices your presence, explaining that Enuo, a fearsome voidsent from the very depths of the ocean, has come to breach the voidgate. While Zero and Golbez contend with Enuo's underlings, you are to confront the dread fiend.

※The Unmaking can be accessed via the Duty Finder.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_07:
Enuo proves a formidable foe, but even with the power of the void at their disposal, they fail to best you and your allies. With the threat now resolved, no doubt Zero will have questions as to how and why you appeared when you did.

※In the event that you leave the area, you may return from the Drowning Brand in Mare Lamentorum.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_08: Back on the red moon, you share news of the voidsent incursion on Etheirys, and learn of Golbez's theory that the barrier separating the Thirteenth and the Source is weakening naturally. Having established a potential explanation for this chain of events, Zero then asks how you came to arrive in the void to begin with. As you describe the golden path to your perplexed comrades, it becomes apparent they can neither see nor interact with it. Realizing that she cannot simply utilize your method to travel to the Source, Zero laments her inability to see her friends once more. Perhaps a particular package of dumplings will serve to lift her spirits.
TEXT_KINGMK103_05472_SEQ_09: Jullus's parcel proves a welcome balm for Zero's melancholy, evoking fond memories of her time in the Source, and leading her to envisage a void in which the existence of cuisine obviated the need for endless consumption of aether. You are left to ponder this hopeful, albeit hard to imagine vision for the Thirteenth...
TEXT_KINGMK104_05473_SEQ_00: Zero has something to discuss with you.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_SEQ_00: Alphinaud continues to grapple with Halmarut's disclosure.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_SEQ_01: Alphinaud states that he wishes to discuss the implications of the Winterers' schemes. Upon hearing this, Alisaie suggests the group convene with the rest of the Scions at the Rising Stones─a plan with which her brother quickly agrees.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_SEQ_02: In the familiar environs of the Rising Stones, you and your comrades attempt to chart a course forward. Though none want for determination and resolve, solutions to the Solstice are not forthcoming. Sensing the need for respite and for those gathered to speak of matters less grave, Tataru calls for a recess. Thus afforded a moment to unwind, it would appear your fellow Scions have much to share.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_SEQ_03: From Thancred and Urianger's foray into the frigid northern reaches of Xak Tural, to the Leveilleur twins' deliberations over how best to communicate their withdrawal from Garlemald, you hear a great deal from your comrades─much of it consequential, some of it refreshingly trivial. Head and heart filled with your colleagues' tales, you turn to speak with Tataru.
TEXT_KINGMK105_05474_SEQ_04: Having retired to Dawn's Respite at Tataru's behest, you find yourself gazing up at the pale face of the moon, contemplating Halmarut's words. As the Ascian's voice rings in your memory, a second abruptly punctuates the quiet night. Calyx, stepping forth onto the terrace, informs you of his impending departure for the Fourth─a world locked in ice and the present target of the Winterers' machinations. While their designs remain unclear, Calyx hints that the group is no monolith when it comes to purpose, even going so far as to decry the methods of his fellow members. As he turns to leave, your foe utters a stark warning: attempting to save all life will merely guarantee oblivion. Despite being privy to the Winterers' ambitions─and now their subsequent destination─the question of how to mount a response remains, for now, unanswered...
